title: Don Nelson, Hall of Fame basketball coach and NBA player, dies at 86
english: Legendary NBA figure Don Nelson has passed away at the age of 86. As a player, he secured five championships with the Boston Celtics, and he later became renowned as a creative coach with the second-most career wins in league history. Known for his innovative 'Nellie Ball' strategy, he left a lasting legacy on the sport and mentored stars like Dirk Nowitzki.
amharic: የቅርጫት ኳስ ታላቁ ሰው ዶን ኔልሰን በ86 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለዩ። እንደ ተጫዋችነት አምስት የኤንቢኤ ዋንጫዎችን ያነሱት ኔልሰን፣ በአሰልጣኝነት ዘመናቸው በሊጉ ታሪክ ሁለተኛው ብዙ ድሎችን በማስመዝገብ ይታወቃሉ። በፈጠራ የተሞላው የጨዋታ ስልታቸው በስፖርቱ ላይ ትልቅ አሻራ ጥሎ ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ዲርክ ኖዊትዝኪ ላሉ ኮከብ ተጫዋቾች መካሪ ነበሩ።
oromo: Leenjisaa fi taphataa kubbaa kashaa NBA beekamaa kan ta'an Don Nelson umurii waggaa 86tti du'aan boqotaniiru. Taphatummaan waggoota dheeraaf taphachaa erga turanii booda, leenjisaa ta'uun galmee seenaa NBA keessatti injifannoo baay'ee argachuun isaan lammaffaa ta'uun isaanii ni yaadatama. Mala taphaa haaraa 'Nellie Ball' jedhamuun beekamtii kan argatan yoo ta'u, taphattoota gurguddoo akka Dirk Nowitzki jedhamaniif barsiisaa gaarii turaniiru.

title: Israeli forces kill one in Gaza as another body recovered from rubble
english: Israeli military actions in Gaza have resulted in at least two recent deaths, including one person shot in Deir el-Balah and another found under building debris. Several civilians, including children, sustained injuries from tank fire and artillery strikes across various parts of the territory. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially turned down a peace proposal suggested by Donald Trump, insisting that military operations will continue.
amharic: በጋዛ በተካሄደው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል፤ አንደኛው በዴር አል-ባላህ በጥይት ሲገደል ሌላኛው ደግሞ ከህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ስር ተገኝቷል። በተለያዩ የጋዛ አካባቢዎች በተከፈተ የተኩስ እና የከባድ መሳሪያ ድብደባ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሲቪሎች ቆስለዋል። በሌላ በኩል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የዶናልድ ትራምፕን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ በማድረግ ወታደራዊ እርምጃው እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel Gazaatti weerara geggeesseen lubbuun namoota lamaa darbeera; tokko naannoo Deir el-Balahitti yoo ajjeefamu, kaan immoo daaraa manaa jalaa argameera. Miidhaan qaamaa fi rukutuun meeshaa waraanaatis naannoolee garaagaraatti daa'imman dabalatee namoota hedduu irra ga'eera. Gama biraatiin, ministirri muummee Benyaamin Netanyaahuu karoorri nagaa Donald Traamp dhiyeessan fudhatama akka hin qabne ibsuun, waraanni itti fufuuf akka jiru mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Solar eclipse tracker: What time will it hit your location on August 12?
english: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will travel across the Arctic, Greenland, Iceland, and Spain. While about 15 million people are in the path of totality where the sun will be completely blocked, nearly one billion people across parts of Europe, Africa, and the United States will be able to see a partial eclipse. This rare event marks the first total solar eclipse in mainland Europe since 1999.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. ነሐሴ 12 ቀን 2026 የሚከሰት አጠቃላይ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ በአርክቲክ፣ በግሪንላንድ፣ በአይስላንድ እና በስፔን በኩል ያልፋል። ወደ 15 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ፀሐይ ሙሉ በሙሉ የምትሸፈንባቸው አካባቢዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ ወደ አንድ ቢሊዮን የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ደግሞ በከፊል ግርዶሹን ማየት ይችላሉ። ይህ ብርቅዬ ክስተት ከ1999 ወዲህ በአውሮፓ ዋና መሬት ላይ የሚታይ የመጀመሪያው ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ይሆናል።
oromo: Guyyaa Hagayya 12, 2026 aduun guutummaatti kan haguugamtu yoo ta'u, kunis Arktik, Gireenlaandi, Aayislaandii fi Ispeen keessatti mul'ata. Namoonni miiliyoona 15 ta'an bakka aduun guutummaatti haguugamtu keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, namoonni biyyoolessa tokkoo ol ta'an immoo adduun hir'attee mul'achuu ishee ilaaluu danda'u. Kunis biyya Awurooppaa keessatti guyyaa bara 1999 booda yeroo jalqabaaf aduun guutummaatti haguugamtu dha.

title: What’s driving unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir?
english: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is currently experiencing its most significant political instability in recent years. Violent demonstrations have erupted in the region as residents head to the final stage of local elections. These ongoing clashes highlight deep-seated tensions within the territory regarding its governance and political future.
amharic: ፓኪስታን የምታስተዳድረው ካሽሚር ባለፉት ጥቂት ዓመታት ውስጥ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። ክልሉ በመጨረሻው የምርጫ ዙር ላይ እያለ ለሞት የሚዳርጉ ተቃውሞዎች እየተካሄዱ ነው። ይህ ሁከት በክልሉ አስተዳደር እና በፖለቲካዊ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ላይ ያለውን ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት ያሳያል።
oromo: Kashmiir kan Paakistaan bulchaa jirtu kun waggoota hedduu keessatti rakkoo siyaasaa hamaa keessa seentee jirti. Naannichi filannoo xumuraa geggeessaa osoo jiruu, hiriirri mormii lubbuu namaa galaafate mudachaa jira. Mormiin kun garaagarummaa bulchiinsa naannichaa fi fuulduree siyaasaa irratti jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Israeli general says Gaza should remain ‘destroyed for generations’
english: A retired Israeli general, Giora Eiland, has publicly suggested that Gaza should stay in a ruined state for decades. He argued that preventing the reconstruction of the territory serves Israel’s interests by keeping the population in a state of deep despair. He views the widespread destruction as a permanent reminder of the events that took place on October 7.
amharic: የቀድሞው የእስራኤል የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ምክር ቤት ኃላፊ ጊዮራ አይላንድ፣ ጋዛ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ፈራርሳ እንድትቆይ ሐሳብ አቅርበዋል። የጋዛን መፈራረስ መከላከል ለእስራኤል ጥቅም ሲባል አስፈላጊ መሆኑን የገለጹት ጄኔራሉ፣ ይህም በነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ተስፋ መቁረጥን እንደሚፈጥር ተናግረዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ውድመት በጥቅምት 7 የተከናወኑትን ክስተቶች ለማስታወስ እንደ ማስረጃ ሆኖ ማገልገል እንዳለበትም ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa Israa'el kan ta'an Giyora Ayilaandi, lafti Gaaza waggoota dheeraaf diigamee akka hafu yaada kennaniiru. Gaaza deebi'ee ijaaramuun faayidaa Israa'el akka hin qabne kan ibsan yoo ta'u, kunis uummata achi keessa jiru abdii kutachiisuuf gargaara jedhaniiru. Miidhaa fi diigamni gurguddaan kun yaadannoo guyyaa Onkoloolessa 7 ta'eef akka ta'uufi kunis Israa'eliif faayidaa akka qabu dubbataniiru.

title: Morning update
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has stated that military forces will remain in Gaza until Hamas completely surrenders its weapons, despite previous peace plan proposals. Meanwhile, Lebanon has threatened to boycott upcoming talks with Israel unless their specific conditions are satisfied. Additionally, a Houthi drone strike in the Yemeni city of Mocha resulted in at least seven deaths and thirty injuries.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ሀማስ መሳሪያውን እስካልፈታ ድረስ ወታደራዊ ኃይላቸው በጋዛ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቀዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሊባኖስ ያቀረበችው ቅድመ ሁኔታ ካልተሟላ በስተቀር ከእስራኤል ጋር በሚደረገው ቀጣይ ውይይት እንደማትሳተፍ ገልጻለች። በየመን የሞቻ ወደብ ከተማ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሠላሳ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahu, dhaabbanni Hamaas meeshaa waraanaa isaa hunda hanga gadi hin dhiisetti waraanni isaanii Gaazaa keessaa akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Libaanoon haala isheen gaafatte yoo hin guutamiin marii Israa'el waliin ta'u irratti hirmaachuu akka dhiistu akeekkachiisteetti. Kana malees, magaalaa Yaman 'Mocha' jedhamtu keessatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen (dronii) garee Huutii qaqqabeen namoonni torba ajjeefamanii soddomni ammoo madaa'aniiru.

title: Union documents 108 Israeli attacks against Palestinian journalists in July
english: The Palestinian Journalists Syndicate reported that Israeli forces carried out 108 violations against media workers during the month of July. These actions included physical assaults, arrests, equipment confiscation, and the raiding of news offices. As a result of these persistent obstacles, journalists are currently unable to safely document and report on events in the region.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጋዜጠኞች ሲንዲኬት በሐምሌ ወር ብቻ በእስራኤል ኃይሎች በጋዜጠኞች ላይ 108 ጥቃቶች መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ድብደባን፣ እስራትን፣ የሥራ መሣሪያዎችን መውረስን እና የቢሮ ወረራዎችን ያካትታሉ። በእነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ እንቅፋቶች ሳቢያ ጋዜጠኞች በክልሉ የሚፈጸሙትን ክስተቶች በነፃነት መዘገብ ተስኗቸዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Gaazexeessitoota Palastayinii, ji'a Adooleessaa keessa qofa waraanni Israa'el gaazexeessitoota irratti haleellaa 108 raawwachuu isaa ibseera. Haleellaan kunneen reebicha, hidhaa, meeshaalee hojii fudhachuu fi mana hojii weeraruu kan dabalatudha. Dhiibbaa fi gufuuwwan kun irra deddeebi'anii mudachaa jiraniin, gaazexeessitoonni naannichatti ta'aa jiru gabaasuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: Wildfires bear down on homes in Canada’s Okanagan region
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in British Columbia, Canada, is threatening residential areas. Authorities have ordered over 20,000 residents in the Okanagan towns of Summerland and Peachland to evacuate for their safety. Emergency teams are working to manage the situation as the fire approaches homes.
amharic: በካናዳ ብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ግዛት የተከሰተ አስደንጋጭ የደን ቃጠሎ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል። የኦካናገን አካባቢ ከተሞች የሆኑት ሰመርላንድ እና ፒችላንድ ነዋሪዎች የሆኑ ከ20,000 በላይ ሰዎች በአስቸኳይ እንዲለቁ ትዕዛዝ ተሰጥቷል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱ ወደ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እየተጠጋ በመሆኑ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወኑ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'achaa jiru kan Kanadaa, naannoo British Columbia keessatti argamu qe'ee namootaa irratti balaa agarsiisaa jira. Aangotni naannichaa jiraattoota magaalaalee Summerland fi Peachland kan ta'an kuma 20 ol ta'an naannicha gadhiisanii akka baqatan ajajaniiru. Ibidni kun gara manneen jireenyaatti dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa balaa kana to'achuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Iran, Oman 'very close' to reaching deal, Araghchi says
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced that Iran and Oman are nearing a final agreement regarding a temporary transit route through the Strait of Hormuz. President Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized that disputes should be handled by a dedicated oversight team rather than through conflict. The leadership suggests a focus on diplomatic cooperation to manage ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ፣ ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ለጊዜያዊ የመተላለፊያ መንገድ የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ መቃረባቸውን ገለጹ። የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማስኡድ 페ዜሽኪያንም በበኩላቸው፣ አለመግባባቶች ግጭትን ከመፍጠር ይልቅ በልዩ ኮሚቴ አማካይነት በውይይት መፈታት እንዳለባቸው አሳስበዋል። መሪዎቹ የቀጠናውን ውጥረት ለመቆጣጠር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ላይ ትኩረት እንደሚያደርጉ አመላክተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, Iraan fi Omaan daandii cehuumsaa yeroof fayyadu kan Hormuz irratti walii galtee dhumaa irra gahuuf dhihaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Preezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan gama isaaniin, rakkoolee uumaman wal dhabdee irra gahuu mannaa garee addunyaa irratti hundaa'e kanaan furuun akka filatamu dubbataniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen dhimmi kun gombisaa fi mariin akka furamu akeekaniiru.

title: US army says 55 commercial vessels redirected amid its blockade against Iran
english: The United States Central Command recently announced that it diverted 55 commercial ships to enforce a blockade against Iran. In addition to these diversions, officials confirmed that two vessels were rendered non-operational, while two others were inspected by military personnel. These actions are part of a broader strategy by U.S. forces to strictly regulate maritime traffic in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ በአንጻሩ ላይ የጣለውን ማዕቀብ ለማስፈጸም 55 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ እንዳስቀየረ አስታውቋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ ሁለት መርከቦች አገልግሎት እንዳይሰጡ መደረጉን እና ሌሎች ሁለት መርከቦችም ደንቦችን መከበራቸውን ለማረጋገጥ መፈተሻቸውን ገልጿል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በአካባቢው ያለውን የባህር ጉዞ በጥብቅ ለመቆጣጠር በሚደረገው ጥረት አካል ናቸው።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galeessa US, Iran irratti duula jiru kabachiisuuf jecha dooniiwwan daldala 55 karaa irraa akka maqfaman beeksisaniiru. Kana malees, dooniiwwan lama hojiin ala ta'anii fi kanneen biroo lama immoo seera eeguu isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf harka waraanaatti akka galfaman ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun to'annoo daandii galaana naannichaa cimsuuf kan taasifame dha.

title: Trump names Will Scharf as White House counsel ahead of midterms
english: President Donald Trump has appointed Will Scharf as his new White House counsel, effective September 1. Scharf, a former federal prosecutor and long-time legal ally, is transitioning from his role as White House staff secretary to replace the outgoing David Warrington. He is well-known for his involvement in key legal battles, including the case that established presidential immunity.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ዊል ሻርፍን አዲሱ የኋይት ሀውስ የህግ አማካሪ አድርገው ሾመዋል። ከዚህ ቀደም የኋይት ሀውስ ሰራተኞች ፀሀፊ ሆነው ሲሰሩ የነበሩት ሻርፍ፣ በመጪው መስከረም 1 ቀን ስራቸውን ይረከባሉ። የቀድሞ የፌደራል አቃቤ ህግ የሆኑት ሻርፍ፣ በፕሬዝዳንቱ የህግ ጉዳዮች ላይ በቅርበት ሲሰሩ የቆዩ ሲሆን በተለይም ለፕሬዝዳንታዊ ያለመከሰስ መብት በተደረገው ክርክር ውስጥ ትልቅ ሚና ነበራቸው።
oromo: Pireezidant Doonald Tiraamp, Wil Shaarf, gorsaa seeraa mana mootummaa (White House) haaraa ta'anii muudaniiru. Shaarf kan duraan barreessaa hojjettootaa ta'anii tajaajilaa turan, gaafa Fulbaana 1 irraa eegalee bakka Daawit Waaringitan bu'uun qabachuuf jiru. Inni duraan abukaatoo federaalaa kan turan yoo ta'u, dhimmoota seeraa Pireezidant Tiraamp irratti gumaacha guddaa gumaachaniiru, keessattuu falmii mirga ittisa pireezidantii irratti gahee murteessaa qabu.

title: Brazilian player falls into tunnel celebrating goal
english: During a Brazilian football match, player Jacy Maranhão accidentally tumbled into the stadium's tunnel while exuberantly celebrating what he thought was a goal. The situation became even more embarrassing when officials reviewed the play and determined the goal was invalid due to an offside violation. Fortunately, the incident was caught on camera, drawing significant attention to his unfortunate celebration.
amharic: በብራዚል በተደረገ የእግር ኳስ ጨዋታ ላይ ጃሲ ማራንሆ የተባለ ተጫዋች ጎል አስቆጥሬያለሁ ብሎ በደስታ ሲዘል በድንገት ወደ ተጫዋቾች መግቢያ ዋሻ ውስጥ ወድቋል። ሁኔታው ይበልጥ አሳፋሪ የሆነው ዳኞች የቪዲዮ ምርመራ ካደረጉ በኋላ ጎሉ ከጨዋታ ውጭ (ኦፍሳይድ) በመሆኑ እንዲሰረዝ ሲወስኑ ነው። ይህ አጋጣሚ በካሜራ የተቀረጸ ሲሆን በብዙዎች ዘንድ መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Tapha kubbaa miilaa biyya Braazil irratti, taphataan Jaasii Maaraaniyaa jedhamu goolii nan galche jedhee gammachuun utaaluu isaa keessatti utaaltee dirree keessaa kufee gara boolla taphattoonni itti seenanitti kute. Haalli isaa kan nama qaanessu ta'ee, abbaan seeraa gooliin kun 'offside' dha jedhee erga dhiisee booda gammachuun isaa faayidaa malee hafe. Taateen kun viidiyoon kan qabame yoo ta'u, namoota hedduu biratti akka waan nama kolfisiisuutti ilaallameera.

title: Trump signals shift to economic pressure on Iran over new military strikes
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the U.S. is prioritizing economic sanctions and a naval blockade over military force to pressure Iran. By monitoring Iran's struggling economy, Washington hopes to reach a diplomatic deal while maintaining stable oil prices at home. Meanwhile, negotiations mediated by Oman are reportedly nearing an agreement to reopen shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከመጠቀም ይልቅ በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና በባህር ዳርቻ እገዳ ላይ ትኩረት እንደምታደርግ አስታውቀዋል። የኢራንን የኢኮኖሚ ድክመት በመጠቀም እና በአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መረጋጋትን በማረጋገጥ ለስምምነት ለመድረስ እየሰሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኦማን በምትደራደረው ድርድር መሰረት የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን ለመክፈት ውይይቶች ወደ መጨረሻው ምዕራፍ መድረሳቸው ተሰምቷል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa waraanaa irra dhiibbaa diinagdee fi uggura galaanaatti fayyadamuun Iraan waliin mariitti akka seenu gochuuf karoorfatteetti. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, dinagdee Iraan miidhame fayyadamuun fi gatii boba'aa biyya keessaa tasgabbeessuun furmaata barbaaduuf yaalameera. Gama biraatiin, mariin Omaan giddu galeessummaan geggeessamaa jiru karaa bidiruu Hormuz deebisee banuuf gara xumuraatti dhiyaachuu gabaasameera.

title: Oil prices climb as Iranian demands cloud outlook for Strait of Hormuz
english: Global oil prices have increased as Iran refuses to reopen the Strait of Hormuz without significant concessions from the United States, including the removal of sanctions and payment of war damages. This major transit route remains largely blocked, causing severe disruptions to the international energy supply and increasing market uncertainty. Traders are becoming more anxious as the lack of a diplomatic breakthrough keeps fuel costs high.
amharic: ኢራን ማዕቀቦችን በማንሳት እና የጦርነት ካሳ በመክፈል ላይ የተመሰረቱ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን እስካላሟላ ድረስ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደማትከፍት በመግለጿ የነዳጅ ዋጋ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ጨምሯል። ይህ ወሳኝ የንግድ መስመር ዝግ ሆኖ መቆየቱ በአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎልን ፈጥሯል። ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ባለመገኘቱ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከፍተኛ ሆኖ እንዲቀጥል እና በገበያው ላይ አለመረጋጋት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል።
oromo: Iraan meeshaalee waraanaa fi kaffaltii miidhaa waraanaa dabalatee haala adda ta'e yoo guutuufiin ala cufaa galaana Hormuz akka hin banne himuun ishee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka olka'u godheera. Daandiin galaana kun cufamee turuun isaa dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaa irratti rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Furmaanni dippilomaasii dhabamuun isaa gatiin boba'aa olka'ee akka itti fufu fi gabaa keessatti yaaddoo akka uumu taasiseera.

title: Clashes in Iraq’s Kut city during protests over power shortages
english: Protests have erupted in the Iraqi city of Kut as residents express frustration over ongoing electricity shortages during extreme heat. Demonstrators gathered outside the Wasit Governorate Council to demand better power services. Security forces intervened using tear gas to manage the rising tensions.
amharic: በኢራቅ ኩት ከተማ ነዋሪዎች በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ወቅት እየተከሰተ ያለውን የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ በመቃወም አደባባይ ወጥተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎች የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት እንዲሻሻል በመጠየቅ በዋሲት ገዢው ምክር ቤት ጽህፈት ቤት ፊት ለፊት ተሰብስበዋል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎችም ውጥረቱን ለመቆጣጠር አስለቃሽ ጭስ ተጠቅመዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Kuut kan Iraaq keessatti, jiraattonni ho'a cimaa keessatti rakkoo dhabama ibsaa mormuun hiriira ba'aniiru. Namoonni hiriira ba'an kun tajaajilli ibsaa akka fooyya'u gaafachuun waajjira bulchiinsa magaalaa Wasit dura walgahaniiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa hiriiricha to'achuuf gaazii imimmaansuu fayyadamaniiru.

title: Houthi attack on Mocha kills seven, Yemeni military says
english: A Houthi drone strike on the Yemeni port city of Mocha has resulted in the deaths of seven people, including both civilians and military members. At least 30 additional individuals sustained injuries during the assault. Yemeni security forces reported that they successfully managed to neutralize 11 of the drones involved in the attack.
amharic: በየመን የሞቻ ወደብ ከተማ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት ሰባት ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተገለጸ። በጥቃቱ የሲቪል እና የውትድርና አባላት የሆኑ ሰባት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 30 ሌሎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የየመን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በጥቃቱ የተሳተፉ 11 ድሮኖችን መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni Houtii magaalaa buufata doonii Mochaa irratti raawwateen namoonni torba ajjeefamaniiru. Miidhaan kun loltootaa fi nagaa buufachuun erga gahe booda, namoonni 30 ol ta’an madaa’aniiru. Humnoonni waraana Yemen duula kana keessatti xiyyaarota nama malee balali’an 11 ta’an gadi buusuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Report: Tensions deepening between US, Israel
english: Diplomatic friction is rising between the United States and Israel as Washington pushes to end ongoing military operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and Iran. During a recent visit to Israel, CENTCOM commander Brad Cooper reportedly urged Israeli officials to move toward concluding these three active fronts. This development signals a strategic push by the U.S. to de-escalate regional conflicts, despite differing priorities between the two allies.
amharic: አሜሪካ በጋዛ፣ በሊባኖስ እና በኢራን እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም ጥረት በማድረጓ በእሷ እና በእስራኤል መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየጨመረ ነው። የአሜሪካ የሴንትኮም አዛዥ ብራድ ኩፐር በቅርቡ እስራኤልን በጎበኙበት ወቅት እነዚህን ሶስት ግንባሮች እንዲዘጉ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካ በክልሉ ያለውን ግጭት ለማርገብ ያላትን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ቢሆንም በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ይበልጥ ጎልቶ እንዲወጣ አድርጓል።
oromo: Amerika waraana Gaaza, Libaanoos fi Iraan keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru dhaabuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtuun wal qabatee, walitti dhufeenyi ishee fi Israa’el gidduu jiru hammaachaa dhufeera. Ajajaan RIB (CENTCOM) Birad Kuupar torbee kana Israa'elitti imala taasisaniin, waraana kana sadan dhaabuuf dhiibbaa gochuun gabaasameera. Tarkaanfiin kun Amerikaan gurguddina waraana naannichaa hir'isuuf akka barbaaddu kan agarsiisu ta'us, garaagarummaan yaadaa gidduu biyyoota lamaanii dabaluu isaa ibsameera.

title: Alleged Irish crime boss Daniel Kinahan in court after Dubai extradition
english: Daniel Kinahan, a suspected Irish crime leader, has appeared in a Dublin court following his extradition from Dubai. The 49-year-old faces serious charges related to his role in managing a criminal organization. He had previously been considered one of the most sought-after individuals by international law enforcement agencies.
amharic: የአየርላንዳዊው የወንጀለኞች ቡድን መሪ ተብሎ የሚጠረጠረው ዳንኤል ኪናሃን ከዱባይ ወደ አየርላንድ ተላልፎ ከተሰጠ በኋላ በደብሊን ፍርድ ቤት ቀረበ። የ49 ዓመቱ ግለሰብ ወንጀለኛ ድርጅትን በበላይነት የመራ ተብሎ ተከሷል። ቀደም ሲል በአለም አቀፍ የፖሊስ ተቋማት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ሲፈለግ የነበረ ግለሰብ ነው።
oromo: Hoggansa garee yakkaa kan biyya Aayerlaand ta'uu shakkamee kan jiru Daani'eel Kiinahaan, biyya Dubaay irraa gara biyya isaatti ergamee booda mana murtii Dubliin dhiyaateera. Namni umriin isaa 49 ta'e kun, dhaabbata yakkaa hordofuun kan himatame yoo ta'u, kanaan dura qaamolee seera kabachiistota addunyaatiin cimaatti barbaadamaa ture.

title: Houthis launch fresh ballistic missile and drone attacks on al-Makha port
english: The Houthi group has carried out new attacks on the Yemeni port of al-Makha using a combination of ballistic missiles and drones. These strikes targeted weapons storage facilities connected to Saudi Arabia. According to reports from the Yemeni military, the assault resulted in the deaths of at least seven individuals.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን አል-ማካ ወደብ ላይ በባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎች እና በድሮኖች ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቱ ሳዑዲ አረቢያን የሚደግፉ የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻዎችን ያነጣጠረ ነበር። የየመን ወታደራዊ መግለጫ እንዳመለከተው፣ በደረሰው ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Gareen Hutiin buufata doonii Al-Makha kan Yaman irratti weerara haarawaa meeshaalee waraanaa fi xiyyara maleeyyii (droniin) fayyadamuun geggeesseera. Weerarchi kun meeshaalee waraanaa kanneen Sa'udii Arabiyaan deeggaramanitti xiyyeeffateera. Gabaasni waraana Yaman akka ibsetti, miidhaa kanaan lubbuun namoota torba ta'uu akka darbe beekameera.

title: Could Morocco’s football chief Fouzi Lekjaa become its next prime minister?
english: Fouzi Lekjaa, a prominent Moroccan official known for his work in finance and football, has joined the Authenticity and Modernity Party ahead of the September parliamentary elections. His entry into partisan politics has sparked widespread discussion about his future, with many speculating he could be a candidate for prime minister. This shift highlights a growing focus on managerial experience, as the next government will be responsible for overseeing the country’s preparations for the 2030 World Cup.
amharic: በሞሮኮ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር እና የֆուትቦል ፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት የሆኑት ፋውዚ ሌክጃ፣ በመጪው መስከረም በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ከመሳተፋቸው በፊት በቅርቡ በአንድ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ውስጥ አባል መሆናቸው ከፍተኛ ውይይት ቀስቅሷል። ይህ ውሳኔ ብዙዎች የሀገሪቱ ቀጣይ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ እንዲገምቱ አድርጓቸዋል። የሚመጣው መንግስት የ2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ዝግጅትን የመምራት ኃላፊነት ስላለበት፣ የአስተዳደር ልምድ ያላቸው ሰዎች መኖራቸው ትልቅ ቦታ ተሰጥቶታል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyya Morookoo kanneen akka ministira bajataa fi pirezidaantii federeeshinii kubbaa miilaa, Foozi Leekjaa, filannoo gara fuulduraatti gaggeeffamuun dura paartii siyaasaa tokkotti makamuun isaanii marii guddaa uumee jira. Tarkaanfiin kun namoonni hedduun inni gara fuulduraatti muummee ministiraa biyyattii ta'uu danda'a jedhanii akka yaadan godhee jira. Mootummaan dhufu qophii Waancaa Addunyaa bara 2030 hordofuu fi hogganuu waan qabuuf, namoonni dandeettii bulchiinsa qaban xiyyeeffannoo argataa jiru.

title: Watch: Netanyahu says Israel 'rejects' Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially dismissed a 15-point peace proposal for Gaza supported by President Donald Trump. He insisted that Israeli forces will remain in the territory and will not retreat until Hamas is completely disarmed. Netanyahu emphasized that his military will continue its operations to protect citizens and neutralize security threats.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተደገፈውን የ15 ነጥብ የጋዛ ሰላም እቅድ በይፋ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ሐማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ጦር የሀገሪቱን ዜጎች ደህንነት ለመጠበቅና ስጋቶችን ለማስወገድ ኦፕሬሽኑን እንደሚቀጥል ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuu karoora nageenyaa Gaazaa kan qabxii 15 of keessaa qabuufi Preezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp deggaran sana guutummaatti didaniiru. Hamni hanga hidhannoo isaa hiikutti waraanni Israa'el naannichaa gadhiisee akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Netanyaahuun waraanni isaanii nageenya lammiilee eeguufi sodaawwan isaan mudatan ittisuuf duula isaanii itti fufsiisuu akka barbaadan mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Lebanon will not take part in next talks with Israel unless demands met: Report
english: Lebanon has announced it will refuse to attend the upcoming September negotiations with Israel unless its specific requirements are fulfilled. The Lebanese government is demanding a complete cease-fire and the immediate cessation of Israeli military construction and destruction activities. Consequently, the schedule for any future talks remains uncertain as Beirut awaits a formal response from Israel regarding these terms.
amharic: ሊባኖስ የኢራኤል ጥያቄዎች እስካልተሟሉ ድረስ በመስከረም ወር ሊካሄድ የታቀደው የድርድር ሂደት እንደማትሳተፍ አስታውቃለች። ሊባኖስ ተኩስ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቆም እና የእስራኤል ጦር የሚያካሂደው የግንባታና የጥፋት ስራ እንዲቆም ቅድመ ሁኔታ አስቀምጣለች። እነዚህ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እስካልተመለሱ ድረስ የድርድሩ ቀጠሮ እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Libanoon yoo gaaffiileen ishee hin guutamne ta'e, marii Isiraa'el waliin ji'a Fulbaanaatti taasifamuuf karoorfame irratti hirmaachuu akka hin barbaanne ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Libaanoos dhukaasa dhaabuu fi waraanni Isiraa'el hojiiwwan diiggaa fi ijaarsa lafa irraatti gaggeessu akka dhaabu gaafachaa jirti. Hanga Isiraa'el haala kanneen irratti waliigaltee kennitutti, guyyaan marii gara fuulduraa kan murtaa'e miti.

title: Israeli attacks in south Lebanon continue, despite truce talks
english: Despite ongoing ceasefire negotiations, Israeli military forces have persisted with artillery and aerial strikes across southern Lebanon. These recent attacks have hit several towns, causing significant destruction. Since March, the conflict has resulted in over 4,300 deaths and more than 12,000 injuries among the Lebanese population.
amharic: የተኩስ አቁም ድርድሮች እየተካሄዱ ቢሆንም፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ የሚሰነዝሩትን የከባድ መሳሪያ እና የአየር ጥቃት ቀጥለዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በተለያዩ የሊባኖስ ከተሞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። ከማርች ወር ወዲህ በተፈጸሙት የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ከ4,300 በላይ ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ከ12,000 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Hanga ammaa mariin tasgabii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamaa jiraatus, waraanni Israa'el kibba Libaanoos irratti haleellaa miilaa fi qilleensa irraa itti fufee jira. Haleellaan kunneen magaalota garaagaraa rukutuun miidhaa hamaa geessisaniiru. Ji'a Bitootessaa irraa jalqabee haleellaa Israa'el kanaan namootni 4,300 ol du'anii, namootni 12,000 ol ta'an immoo madaa'aniiru.

title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, says Netanyahu
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has formally rejected a 15-point peace proposal for Gaza promoted by Donald Trump. Netanyahu stated that Israel will refuse to pull its forces out of the region until Hamas completely gives up its arms. Despite earlier reports suggesting both parties had agreed to the plan, ongoing military strikes continue as the Israeli government stands firm on its security requirements.

oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun sagantaa nagaa Gaazaaf dhiyaate kan qabxii 15 of keessatti qabatu kan Donald Traamp durfamuufi mormaniiru. Netanyaahuun hamma Hamas guutummaatti meeshaa waraanaa hiikutti Israa'el waraana ishee Gaazaa keessaa akka hin baafne ibsaniiru. Kanaan dura garuun lamaanuu walii galuu isaanii kan gabaafame ta'us, Israa'el tarkaanfii waraanaa ishee itti fufuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is rooted in a cultural tendency to view authority as a tool for dominance rather than cooperation. From households to schools and workplaces, society often encourages unquestioning obedience, where dissent is frequently mistaken for disloyalty. This deeply embedded social pattern limits democratic growth by teaching individuals to prioritize submission and hierarchy over open dialogue.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዴሞክራሲ ፈተና ሥር የሰደደው ስልጣንን ለትብብር ሳይሆን ለ የበላይነት የመጠቀም ባህል ነው። ከቤተሰብ ጀምሮ እስከ ትምህርት ቤቶችና የስራ ቦታዎች ድረስ፣ ማህበረሰቡ ጥያቄ ሳያነሱ መታዘዝን የሚያበረታታ ሲሆን፣ የተለየ አስተያየት መኖር እንደ ታማኝነት ማጉደል ይቆጠራል። ይህ በህብረተሰቡ ውስጥ የገባው የአስተሳሰብ ዘይቤ፣ ግለሰቦች ግልጽ ውይይትን ከመተግበር ይልቅ ለስልጣን መገዛትን እንዲያቀድሙ በማድረግ የዴሞክራሲን እድገት ይገድባል።
oromo: Rakkoon demokraasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu aadaa aangoo akka meeshaa ittiin wal-caaluu fi ajajuutti fayyadamu malee, akka meeshaa waliin hojjechuutti ilaaluu dadhabuurraa madda. Mana jireenyaa, mana barnootaa fi bakka hojiitti, hawaasni namoota akka waan hundumaa tole jedhanii fudhatanitti waan jajjabeessuuf, yaada mormii dhiyyeessuu akka amanamummaa dhabuutti ilaalama. Akkaataan itti yaadaa hawaasaa kun, namoonni marii banuu mannaa aangoo fi sadarkaaf jedhanii akka garraamifatan waan taasisuuf, guddinni demokraasii akka daangeffamu taasisa.

title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
english: Eight South African military personnel have been accused of murdering high-ranking detective Frans Mathipa, who was shot while investigating sensitive cases involving special forces. Evidence obtained by the BBC suggests that military-linked vehicles tracked the detective shortly before his death. Despite the gravity of the charges, legal proceedings have stalled as some suspects remain in their military positions, raising concerns about potential interference and a lack of accountability.
amharic: ስምንት የደቡብ አፍሪካ ወታደራዊ አባላት ከፍተኛውን መርማሪ ፍራንስ ማቲፓን በመግደል ተከሰሱ። መርማሪው ለልዩ ኃይሎች ጉዳይ ምርመራ ሲያደርጉ እንደነበረ እና በዚህ ሂደት ላይ እያሉ እንደተገደሉ ይነገራል። የቢቢሲ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪዎች መርማሪውን ተከታትለው እንደነበር ማስረጃዎች አሉ። ምንም እንኳን ክሱ ከባድ ቢሆንም ተከሳሾቹ አሁንም በወታደራዊ ስራቸው ላይ በመሆናቸው ፍትህ ሊጓተት ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።

title: Houthis renew missile and drone attacks on Yemen’s port of al-Makha
english: Houthi forces have conducted a series of missile and drone strikes against the Yemeni port city of al-Makha, resulting in at least 11 deaths and significant damage to commercial infrastructure. These back-to-back attacks targeted areas held by the government, with the Houthis claiming they were in response to a military buildup by Saudi-backed forces. Government authorities reported intercepting several drones and missiles, while calling on local residents to stay inside for safety as the situation remains volatile.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን አል-መኻ ወደብ ከተማ ላይ በተከታታይ የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። ጥቃቱ ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን በወደቡ መሠረተ ልማት እና በንግድ ተቋማት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ሁቲዎች ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት የሳውዲ ደጋፊ ኃይሎች በምዕራብ የመን ወታደራዊ ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ነው በሚል ሰበብ ነው። የየመን መንግሥት ኃይሎች ጥቃቱን ለመመከት ቢሞክሩም፣ ግጭቱ በአካባቢው ያለውን የጸጥታ ሁኔታ አባብሶታል።

Houthin haleellaa kana kan raawwatan humnoota Sa'udii deggaraman waliin wal-qabsiisudhaan ta'uus, mootummaan Yemen gama isaatiin haleellicha ittisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira. Haala kana hordofee, jiraattonni naannichaa tasgabbii akka eeggatan fi manatti akka turan gorfamaniiru.

title: Iran war live: US ‘semi-negotiating’ with Tehran; Israel rejects Gaza plan
english: President Trump stated that the US is only partially engaging in talks with Iran, preferring to rely on growing economic pressure. Meanwhile, Iranian officials deny any direct negotiations and maintain that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until their specific demands are met. Additionally, Israel has formally turned down a proposed peace initiative for Gaza.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር በከፊል ብቻ እየተደራደረች እንደሆነ እና በኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ውጤት ለማምጣት እየጠበቁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው ምንም አይነት ቀጥተኛ ንግግር እንደሌለ በመግለጽ፣ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ እስከሚጠየቁት የኢኮኖሚ እፎይታዎች ድረስ ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ አረጋግጠዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም እስራኤል ለጋዛ የቀረበውን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ አድርጋለች።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Traamp akka jedhanitti, Yuunisni Ameerikaa Iran waliin marii gadi fageenya hin qabne kan taasisaa jirtu yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa diinagdee irra caalu uumuuf eegaa jiru. Gammachuu biraatiin, qondaalonni Iran mariin kallattii tokko illee akka hin jirre ibsuun, hanga fedhiin isaanii guututti daandiin galaana Hormuz cufaa akka ta'u mirkaneessaniiru. Kana malees, Israa'el karoora nagaa Gaazaaf dhiyaate guutummaatti diddeetti.

title: F-16s intercept two aircraft near Trump’s New Jersey golf club
english: US fighter jets were scrambled to intercept two civilian planes that flew into unauthorized airspace near a golf course in New Jersey. At the time of the incident, former President Donald Trump was present at the property attending a tournament. Officials from NORAD confirmed that the military aircraft intervened to address the safety breach in the restricted area.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በኒው ጀርሲ በሚገኘው የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጎልፍ ሜዳ አቅራቢያ በተከለከለ የአየር ክልል ውስጥ የገቡ ሁለት ሲቪል አውሮፕላኖችን አቋርጠው አስቆሙ። ክስተቱ በተከሰተበት ወቅት የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቦታው ተገኝተው ውድድር እየተመለከቱ ነበር። የሰሜን አሜሪካ የአየር መከላከያ ዕዝ (NORAD) እንደገለጸው፣ የጦር አውሮፕላኖቹ በክልከላው አካባቢ የተፈጠረውን የደህንነት ጥሰት ለመቆጣጠር ጣልቃ ገብተዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarotni waraana Ameerikaa xiyyaarota sivilii lama kanneen iddoo golfii Donald Trump, New Jerseyitti argamu kan hayyama hin qabne cabsanii seenan hordofuun dhaabsisaniiru. Yeroo kana duraani pirezidaant Donald Trump iddoo sanatti tapha tokko hordofaa turan. Abbootiin taayitaa ittisa qilleensaa kan NORAD akka ibsanitti, xiyyaarotni waraana kun bakka dhorkaa ta'e sana keessatti nageenyi akka hin boorofneef tarkaanfii fudhataniiru.

title: Union reports 108 attacks on Palestinian journalists in July
english: The Palestinian Journalists Syndicate recorded 108 separate attacks on media workers by Israeli forces and settlers during July in the occupied West Bank. These violations included physical assaults, arbitrary detentions, the destruction of equipment, and the obstruction of reporting activities. This recent spike in violence contributes to a broader, historic trend that has seen over 270 journalists killed since October 2023.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጋዜጠኞች ማህበር በሐምሌ ወር ብቻ በእስራኤል ኃይሎች እና በሰፋሪዎች የተፈጸሙ 108 የጥቃት ድርጊቶችን መዝግቧል። እነዚህ ጥሰቶች አካላዊ ጥቃትን፣ ያለ አግባብ ማሰርን፣ የመገናኛ ብዙሃን መሳሪያዎችን ማውደምን እና የጋዜጠኝነት ስራን ማደናቀፍን ያካትታሉ። ይህ የቅርብ ጊዜ የጥቃት ጭማሪ ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ ከ270 በላይ ጋዜጠኞች ለህልፈት የተዳረጉበትን አሳዛኝ ታሪካዊ ክስተት የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Gamtaan Gaazexeessitoota Palastiinii akka gabaasetti, ji'a Adooleessa keessa qofaa humnoota Israa'elii fi qonnattootaan gaazexeessitoota irratti haleellaan 108 raawwatameera. Haleellaan kunneen reebicha, hidhaa seeran alaa, meeshaalee hojii mancaasuu fi hojii gabaasaa gufachiisuu kan dabalatuudha. Daballiin haleellaa kanaa, erga Adoolessa 2023 as gaazexeessitoonni 270 ol ajjeefamuu isaanii waliin walqabatee, haalli kun yeroo hunda caalaa gaazexeessitootaaf kan sodaachisu ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: What’s driving unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir?
english: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is currently experiencing significant political instability and fatal demonstrations. These protests are occurring during a critical period leading up to the final stage of regional elections. The unrest highlights deep-seated tensions within the disputed territory.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር ክልል ከባድ የፖለቲካ ቀውስ እና ገዳይ ተቃውሞዎች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው የምርጫ ሂደት የመጨረሻ ዙር እየተቃረበ ባለበት ወቅት የተቀሰቀሱ ናቸው። የዚህ ቀውስ መንስኤም በክልሉ ውስጥ ባለው ረዘም ያለ የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት እና ውጥረት የተነሳ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Kaashmiir kan Paakistaan bulchaa jirtu keessatti rakkoon siyaasaa cimaafi hiriirri lubbuu galaafate mudachaa jira. Hiriirri kun kan ta'e adeemsa filannoo naannichaa xumura irra ga'e dura. Rakkoon kunis sababa gaaffiiwwan siyaasaa naannichaa keessatti walxaxaa ta'anii fi tasgabbii dhabuu irraa kan maddeedha.

title: Trump shares Clinton defence of Gaza plan after Netanyahu rejects roadmap
english: President Trump recently shared an opinion piece by Hillary Clinton that supports his Gaza peace proposal. This move comes shortly after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu officially rejected the plan. While Trump publicized the endorsement, he has not yet commented on Netanyahu's decision or indicated how the US might respond.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅዳቸውን የሚደግፍ የሂላሪ ክሊንተን ጽሁፍ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያቸው ላይ አጋርተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የትራምፕን ዕቅድ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። ትራምፕ ይህን ድጋፍ ቢያሳዩም፣ ስለ ኔታንያሁ ውሳኔ ወይም በአሜሪካ መንግስት ቀጣይ እርምጃ ላይ እስካሁን የሰጡት አስተያየት የለም።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp yaada Hillary Clinton kan karoora isaanii kan gaza deggeru miidiyaarratti qoodaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun kan fudhatame erga Muummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu karoora kana fudhachuu didanii boodadha. Traamp deggersa kana kan ibsan ta'us, murtii Netanyahu irratti ykn tarkaanfii mootummaan Ameerikaa gara fuulduraatti fudhatu irratti hanga ammaatti waan tokko hin jedhani.

title: Board of Peace envoy says Israel not required to withdraw from Gaza
english: A senior envoy from the Board of Peace has clarified that Israel is not obligated to pull its troops out of Gaza until Palestinian factions successfully disarm. This new stance follows Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s rejection of the proposed peace roadmap, as he insists on maintaining the right to conduct military strikes. The verification process for disarmament will be overseen by the United States with assistance from Turkey and Qatar.
amharic: የሰላም ቦርድ ከፍተኛ ተወካይ እስራኤል የፍልስጤም ቡድኖች ትጥቃቸውን እስኪፈቱ ድረስ ከጋዛ ወታደሮቿን የማስወጣት ግዴታ እንደሌለባት ገልጸዋል። ይህ አቋም የመጣው የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሰላም ዕቅዱን ውድቅ በማድረጋቸው እና ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የመውሰድ መብታቸውን በማረጋገጣቸው ነው። የትጥቅ መፍታት ሂደቱ በአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር ስር ሆኖ በቱርክ እና በኳታር ድጋፍ የሚከናወን ይሆናል።
oromo: Ergamoon olaanaa Boordii Nageenyaa akka ibsanitti, gareewwan Falasxiin meeshaa waraanaa isaanii harka kennuufi hiikuu hanga hin jalqabnetti, Israa'el loltoota ishee Gaazaa irraa baasuf dirqama hin qabdu. Haalli kun kan hordofe erga muummeen ministiraa Israa'el Binyamin Netanyaahuun karooricha didanii fi waraana gaggeessuuf mirga qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneeffatan booda. Adeemsi meeshaa hiikkachiisuu kunis to'annoo Ameerikaa jalatti, deeggarsa Turkiifi Qaataridhaan kan raawwatamu ta'a.

title: Germany warns of ‘daily hybrid warfare’ after explosive-laden drone found
english: Germany's Interior Minister has warned that the country is facing constant hybrid warfare, including sabotage and cyberattacks, following the discovery of an explosive-laden drone at a major airport. While no specific country was blamed, officials suggest these foreign-led actions aim to destabilize German society and spread fear. In response, the government plans to double its anti-drone security forces and expand its monitoring capabilities to address these growing threats.
amharic: ጀርመን በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያዋ ላይ ፈንጂ የተጫነ ድሮን ከተገኘ በኋላ፣ አገሪቱ በየቀኑ በሳይበር ጥቃቶችና በሽብር ተግባራት የተሞላ ድብቅ ጦርነት እየተካሄደባት እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች። የውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ እነዚህ የውጭ ኃይሎች የሚፈጽሟቸው ድርጊቶች የጀርመንን ማህበረሰብ ለማተራመስ ያለሙ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህንን ስጋት ለመከላከል መንግስት የፀረ-ድሮን ባለሙያዎችን ቁጥር በእጥፍ ለማሳደግና የደህንነት ቁጥጥሩን ለማጠናከር እቅድ አውጥቷል።
oromo: Jarmaniin buufata xiyyaaraa ishee tokko irratti xiyyaara nama malee balali'u (drone) funjii fe'e erga argattee booda, biyyattiin waraana dhokataa fi qormata guyyuu keessa jirtu jedhaniiru. Ministirri dhimma keessaa akka jedhanitti, gochootni alaa dhufan kun hawaasa Jarman tasgabbii dhabsiisuuf kan karoorfaman dha. Rakkoo kana ittisuuf mootummaan garee ittisa drone kan amma jiru dachaan dabaluuf akkasumas too'annoo nageenyaa isaa bal'isuuf qophiirra jira.

title: Palestinians say Netanyahu’s decision leaves ‘no clear path’ to peace
english: Palestinian officials and residents are concerned after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected a U.S.-supported peace proposal. They believe this decision removes any realistic strategy for ending the ongoing conflict in Gaza. While Hamas has expressed willingness to follow the agreement, the lack of cooperation from the Israeli government has created a sense of hopelessness regarding the peace process.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን የሰላም ዕቅድ ውድቅ ማድረጋቸው በፍልስጤማውያን ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ይህ ውሳኔ በጋዛ ያለውን ጦርነት ለመጨረስ የሚያስችል ግልጽ መንገድ እንደሌለ አድርጎታል። ሀማስ ለስምምነቱ ዝግጁ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ የእስራኤል መንግሥት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆን በሰላም ሂደቱ ላይ ተስፋ አስቆራጭ ሁኔታን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu sagantaa nagaa kan Ameerikaan deggerame diduun isaanii, lammiilee Falasxiin biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera. Murteen kun waraana Gaaza keessatti adeemaa jiru xumuruuf karaa ifa ta'e akka hin jirre agarsiisa. Haamas walii galicha fudhachuuf fedhii qabaatus, mootummaan Israa'el fedhii dhabuun isaa nagaa buusuuf abdii kutachiiseera.

title: Israeli pilot trainee dies by suicide at military base
english: An Israeli Air Force pilot trainee tragically ended their own life at a military installation in southern Israel this past Sunday. This incident contributes to a concerning trend, as reported statistics indicate that at least 18 active military personnel have died by suicide since the beginning of 2026. Authorities are currently addressing the impact of these ongoing losses within the armed forces.
amharic: ባለፈው እሁድ በእስራኤል ደቡባዊ ክፍል በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ ውስጥ አንድ የአየር ኃይል የበረራ ሰልጣኝ ራሱን አጥፍቷል። እንደ ሃሬትዝ ጋዜጣ መረጃ ከሆነ፣ ከፈረንጆቹ 2026 መጀመሪያ አንስቶ ቢያንስ 18 ንቁ ወታደሮች በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በሠራዊቱ ውስጥ እየተከሰተ ያለውን የወታደሮች የራስ ማጥፋት ችግር አመላካች ሆኗል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe buufata waraanaa kibba Israaʼelitti barataan qilleensa irraa tokko of ajjeeseera. Gabaasni gaazexaa Haaretz akka mulʼisutti, jalqaba bara 2026 irraa kaasee waraana hojii irra jiran keessaa namoonni 18 ol of ajjeesuun isaanii beekameera. Rakkoon kun humna waraanaa keessatti kan xiyyeeffannoo barbaadu ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Israeli general says Gaza should remain ‘destroyed for generations’
english: Retired Israeli Major General Giora Eiland has publicly argued that Gaza should remain in ruins for generations to serve as a deterrent following the October 7 attacks. He believes that preventing the reconstruction of the enclave aligns with Israel's strategic interests and maintains a necessary security buffer. Eiland also suggested that Israel should retain significant portions of Gazan territory and criticized the current leadership's handling of diplomatic relations with the United States.
amharic: የጡረታ የወጡት የእስራኤል ጄኔራል ጊዮራ አይላንድ፣ በጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት ምክንያት ጋዛ ለብዙ ትውልዶች በውድመት ውስጥ መቆየት አለባት ሲሉ ተናግረዋል። የጋዛን አካባቢ መልሶ መገንባት ለእስራኤል ጥቅም እንደማይሰጥ የገለጹት ጄኔራሉ፣ አካባቢው የጥፋት ምልክት ሆኖ መቀጠሉ ለደህንነት መከላከያነት ያገለግላል ብለዋል። በተጨማሪም እስራኤል የተወሰነ የጋዛ መሬትን በቁጥጥሯ ስር ማቆየት እንዳለባት የጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ አሁን ባለው የፖለቲካ አመራር ከአሜሪካ ጋር ባለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ላይም ትችት ሰንዝረዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa Israa'el kan ta'an Giora Eiland, erga haleellaa Onkoloolessa 7 gaggeeffamee booda, Gaazaan dhaloota dhufuuf akka baddee fi diigamtee turuu qabdi jechuun dubbataniiru. Magaalattiin deebi'ee ijaaramuun ishee faayidaa Israa'el akka hin qabne fi bakki diigamte sun mallattoo akeekkachiisaa ta'ee akka turu barbaadu. Akkasumas, Israa'el lafa Gaazaa keessaa bakka tokko to'annoo ishee jala akka turfatufi hoogganoota ammaa hariiroo Ameerikaa wajjin qabanirratti komii kaaseera.

title: Drones spotted over German base days after Leipzig bomb incident
english: Unidentified drones were recently observed flying over a German military base that houses components for Patriot air-defense systems. This security incident follows the discovery of an explosive-laden drone at Leipzig airport, raising concerns about potential hybrid warfare. German officials are currently investigating these sightings, as fears grow regarding increased hostile activities targeting nations that support Ukraine.
amharic: ያልታወቁ ድሮኖች የጀርመን የጦር ሰፈር በሆነውና ለፓትሪዮት የአየር መከላከያ ሲስተሞች የሚሆኑ መለዋወጫዎች ባሉበት ቦታ ላይ ታይተዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሌይፕዚግ አየር ማረፊያ ፈንጂ የጫነ ድሮን ከተገኘ በኋላ የተከሰተ በመሆኑ፣ ሀገሪቱ በድብቅ የጦርነት ጥቃቶች ላይ እንደምትገኝ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት በዩክሬን ድጋፍ በሚሰጡ ሀገራት ላይ እየተደረጉ ያሉትን እነዚህን አጠራጣሪ እንቅስቃሴዎች በምርመራ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyoorrannii dhoksaa kanneen meeshaalee ittisa qilleensaa kanneen Paatriyooti itti kuufaman buufata waraana Jarmanii tokko irratti argamaniiru. Gochi kun erga buufata xiyyaaraa Leepziigitti xiyyiitii ykn meeshaa lolaa fe'ate tokko erga argamee guyyoota muraasa booda kan mudate yoo ta'u, kunis waraana ammayyaa ykn 'hybrid warfare' ilaalchisee yaaddoo uumeera. Aangeyyoonni Jarmanii, biyyoota Yukreen deeggaran irratti qaxxaamuraa jiran jedhamuun kanneen shakkaraman irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Israel is ‘trying to make Palestine disappear’: The Elders
english: The group known as 'The Elders,' which includes former Irish President Mary Robinson, has accused Israel of actively working to eliminate Palestine's presence. Following a visit to the West Bank, the delegation reported that Israel is systematically undermining Palestinian society through economic, cultural, and political means. The group highlighted concerns over growing hate speech and the lack of consequences for soldiers and settlers who seize Palestinian land.
amharic: ሜሪ ሮቢንሰንን ጨምሮ 'ዘ ኤልደርስ' የተባለው ቡድን እስራኤል የፍልስጤምን ህልውና ለማጥፋት እየሰራች ነው ሲል ከሰሰ። ቡድኑ በምዕራብ ባንክ ካደረገው ጉብኝት በኋላ እስራኤል በፍልስጤም ማህበረሰብ ላይ ኢኮኖሚያዊ፣ ባህላዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ጫናዎችን እያሳደረች መሆኑን ገልጿል። እንዲሁም በእስራኤል መንግስት በኩል ለሰፈራ እና ለወታደሮች ጥቃት ተጠያቂነት አለመኖሩን እና የጥላቻ ንግግሮች እየጨመሩ መምጣታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Gareen 'The Elders' jedhamu fi dura ta'aa biyya Ayirland kan turan Meeri Roobinsan, Israa'el biyya Filisxeem lafa irraa haquuf sochii gochaa akka jirtu himatan. Gareen kun gara baankii dhihaa erga daawwatanii booda, Israa'el diinagdee, aadaa fi siyaasa Filisxeemirratti dhiibbaa guddaa gochaa akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, mootummaan Israa'el loltootaa fi namoota lafa butatan irratti tarkaanfii waan hin fudhanneef, haalli kun haala gaariin itti hin fufne jechuun himatan.

title: Can the Doha Framework end the conflict in eastern DRC?
english: The peace process in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is showing signs of progress following months of stagnation. The M23 rebel group recently received 15 prisoners from the Kinshasa government as part of a Qatari-mediated peace framework. While this is a modest development, it offers potential hope for resolving the long-standing instability in the region.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል ለወራት ተቋርጦ የነበረው የሰላም ሂደት አሁን ላይ መሻሻል እያሳየ ይገኛል። የኤም 23 አማፂ ቡድን በኳታር አደራዳሪነት በተፈረመው ስምምነት መሰረት ከኪንሻሳ መንግስት 15 እስረኞችን ተረክቧል። ይህ እርምጃ ትንሽ ቢመስልም በክልሉ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ግጭት ለመፍታት አዲስ ተስፋ ሊፈነጥቅ ይችላል።
oromo: Adeemsi nagaa baha Rippaablika Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti waggoota hedduuf ture erga dhaabbatee booda amma gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachaa jira. Gareen ribeloota M23 jedhamu, waliigaltee Qaxariin giddu-galeessa taatee mallatteeffame hordofee hidhamtoota 15 mootummaa Kinshasaa irraa fudhateera. Tarkaanfiin kun xiqqoo fakkaatus, walitti buiinsa naannichaa yeroo dheeraaf ture xumuruuf abdii gaarii ta'uu danda'a.

title: Hundreds of anti-tourism Spanish protesters march in Mallorca’s Soller
english: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered in the town of Soller on the Spanish island of Mallorca to protest against mass tourism. The participants expressed concerns that the high influx of visitors is driving up living costs for residents. They also highlighted that local people are struggling to find affordable housing due to the impact of the tourism industry.
amharic: በስፔኗ ማሎርካ ደሴት ሶለር ከተማ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በጅምላ ቱሪዝም ላይ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በቱሪስቶች መብዛት ሳቢያ የኑሮ ውድነት እንደጨመረ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም በቱሪዝም ዘርፉ ምክንያት የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ተመጣጣኝ የቤት ኪራይ ማግኘት ተቸግረዋል ብለዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Soller kan odoola Maalloorkaatti argamutti, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman turiizimii hunda-galeessa mormuun hiriira ba'aniiru. Hiriirtonni kun turiizimiin daran dabaluun isaa gatiin jireenyaa akka ol ka'u taasisuu isaa ibsaniiru. Kana malees, turiizimichi qabeenya mana jireenyaa irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, jiraattonni naannichaa mana jireenyaa gatiin isaa madaalawaa ta'e argachuun itti ulfaachuu isaa himaniiru.

title: Iran appoints former IRGC chief to top security post
english: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei has appointed Mohsen Rezaee, a former commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, as the new secretary of the Supreme National Security Council. Rezaee, a veteran of the Iran-Iraq War, will also act as the leader’s personal representative on this influential body. This leadership change involves replacing Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, who has been reassigned to a political advisory role.
amharic: የኢራኑ የበላይ መሪ አያቶላ ካሜኒ የቀድሞውን የእስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ጥበቃ ጦር አዛዥ ሞህሰን ረዛኢን የከፍተኛ ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ምክር ቤት ፀሐፊ አድርገው ሾሙ። በኢራን-ኢራቅ ጦርነት ተሳትፎ የነበራቸው ረዛኢ፣ በአዲሱ ኃላፊነታቸው ከመሪው የግል ተወካይነት በተጨማሪ በሀገሪቱ የጸጥታና መከላከያ ውሳኔዎች ላይ ቁልፍ ሚና ይኖራቸዋል። ይህ ሹመት የተካሄደው የቀድሞውን ኃላፊ መሐመድ ባጌር ዘልጋድርን ወደ አማካሪነት በመቀየር ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Iraan Ayatolla Khameneen ajajaa duraanii garee 'Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' kan ta'an Mohsen Rezaee barreessaa 'Supreme National Security Council' haaraa godhatanii muudaniiru. Rezaee waraana Iraan fi Iraaq irratti muuxannoo kan qaban yoo ta'u, kanaan boodas bakka bu'aa hoggansaa ta'anii dhimmoota nageenyaa biyyattii irratti murtoo guddaa ni kennu. Muudamni kun kan raawwatame Mohammed Bagher Zolghadr bakka isaanii akka jijjiiramu godhamee, isaaniis gara gorsaatti ramadamaniiru.

title: Egypt calls for full Israeli withdrawal and unrestricted aid access to Gaza
english: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty has formally requested that Israel withdraw all its forces from Gaza and ensure continuous humanitarian aid reaches the area. These demands were discussed alongside a proposed international security force intended to manage the region, as outlined in a peace initiative associated with Donald Trump. However, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has already dismissed the peace proposal, creating significant uncertainty about the future of these diplomatic efforts.
amharic: የግብፅ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ባድር አብደላቲ እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ ሙሉ ለሙሉ እንድታስወጣ እና ሰብአዊ እርዳታዎች ያለገደብ እንዲገቡ ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ ጥያቄዎች የቀረቡት በዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሰላም ዕቅድ አካል የሆነውን የአለም አቀፍ የፀጥታ አስከባሪ ኃይል የማሰማራት ጉዳይ በተወያዩበት ወቅት ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሰላም ዕቅዱን ውድቅ በማድረጋቸው፣ የዲፕሎማሲው ጥረት ስኬታማነት አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Masri Badr Abdelatty, Israa'el loltootashee Gaza irraa guutummaatti akka baastu fi gargaarsi namoomaa daangaa malee akka seenu gaafataniiru. Gaaffiin kun kan dhihaate karoora nagaa Donald Trump keessatti kan ibsame humna nageenyaa idil-addunyaa Gaza keessatti bobbaasuurratti mari'atamaa jirutti. Haa ta'u malee, Muummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu karoora nagaa kana waan didaniif, carraan mariin kun milkaa'uuf qabu shakkii keessa galeera.

title: Where does Iran stand on Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye pact?
english: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye have formed a new trilateral defense pact pledging mutual support against external military threats. While the alliance coincides with ongoing regional conflicts, these nations emphasize that the agreement is not intended to target Iran. Tehran has responded cautiously, viewing the deal as a sign of the United States' diminishing influence in the Middle East while remaining watchful of long-term security implications.

oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Paakistaanii fi Turkiin waliigaltee ittisaa haaraa kan biyyoonni sadanuu wal gargaaran waraana alaa kamiyyuu irratti hundeeffataniiru. Biyyoonni kunneen waliigalteen kun biyya kamiyyuu keessattuu Iraan irratti kan xiyyeeffate miti jedhaniiru. Iraan gama ishiitiin waliigaltee kana sodaa irraa kan maddeen ta'us, dhufuu isaa akka mallattoo dhiibbaan Ameerikaa naannichatti hir'achaa deemuutti ilaaluun tasgabbii agarsiisteetti.

title: Trump says US is ‘only semi-negotiating’ with Iran
english: President Donald Trump claims that the United States is currently engaged in only limited, informal talks with Iran. He argues that Iran is facing severe financial instability and high inflation due to American sanctions and naval blockades. Despite these tensions, Trump remains optimistic that the situation will eventually be resolved like a game of chess.

oromo: Preezidaantiin Donald Traamp akka jedhanitti, yeroo ammaa Yunaayitid Isteets fi Iraan gidduutti mariin taasifamaa jiru daangeeffamaa fi wal-xaxaa dha. Iraan tarkaanfii diinagdee Ameerikaa fi dhorkaa galaanaatiin rakkoo dinagdee cimaa fi infilaashinii keessa akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Haalli kun akka tapha shaatranjii ta'uu fi gara fuulduraatti furmaata akka argatuuf abdii qabaachuu isaanii dubbataniiru.

title: Trump could declare victory if Iran reopens Strait of Hormuz: Report
english: President Trump is reportedly considering declaring a victory over Iran if Tehran allows free shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. While he may abandon the pursuit of a new nuclear deal, he intends to keep forces in the area to deter future attacks on vessels and monitor for any nuclear facility reconstruction. This approach would allow for an indefinite ceasefire provided that oil transit remains secure and Iran does not resume its nuclear program.

oromo: Pireezidanti tiraamp, Iiraan karaa galaana Hormuzn imala doonii akka deebi'u yoo heyyamte injifannoo akka argatan labsuuf karoorfachaa jiru. Walii galtee niwukileraa haaraa irratti xiyyeeffachuu mannaa, nagayaan dhiyeessiin boba'aa akka itti fufuufi galaanichi banamaa akka ta'uuf dursanii jiru. Haalli kun, Iiraan sagantaa niwukileraa ishee akka hin jalqabne hanga mirkanaa'etti, dhaabbannii waraanaa akka itti fufuufi hariiroon isaanii akka tasgabbaa'uuf gargaara.

title: Jannik Sinner withdraws from Cincinnati Open with knee injury
english: World number one tennis player Jannik Sinner has decided to skip the Cincinnati Open because of a recurring right knee injury. After consulting with his medical team, the Italian athlete determined he is not fit enough to compete in the tournament. His withdrawal follows a similar move by Carlos Alcaraz as both players prioritize their health before the upcoming US Open.
amharic: የዓለም የቴኒስ ደረጃ አንደኛ የሆነው ያኒክ ሲነር በቀኝ ጉልበቱ ላይ በደረሰበት ጉዳት ምክንያት በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ እንደማይሳተፍ አስታውቋል። ስፖርተኛው ከህክምና ቡድኑ ጋር ከተመካከረ በኋላ ለውድድር ዝግጁ እንዳልሆነ በመግለጽ ውድድሩን መልቀቁን አሳውቋል። እንደ ካርሎስ አልካራዝ ሁሉ ሲነርም በነሐሴ መጨረሻ በሚጀመረው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ ለመሳተፍ ሲል ጤንነቱን ቀዳሚ አድርጓል።
oromo: Taphatni tenisiin addunyaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamu Jannik Sinner miidhaa jilba mirgaa isaatiin kan ka’e dorgommii Cincinnati Open irratti akka hin hirmaanne beeksiseera. Ogeeyyii fayyaa isaa waliin mari’ateen booda, dorgommichaaf qophii akka hin taane hubatee akka dhiisu murteesseera. Sinner akkaataa Carlos Alcaraz dorgommicha itti dhiise walfakkaatuun, dorgommii US Open dhufaa jiruuf fayyummaa isaa dursuuf jecha murtee kana fudhateera.

title: Former Iraqi provincial governor arrested as graft crackdown continues
english: Former Saladin province governor Ahmed al-Jubouri was arrested in Baghdad on corruption charges involving the misuse of contract funds. A close business associate was also detained in connection with the same investigation. This arrest is part of a broader government campaign to combat graft, which has already seen numerous high-profile officials taken into custody this year.

oromo: Bulchaan duraanii godina Saladin, Ahmed al-Jubouri, maallaqa waliigaltee mootummaa karaa seeraan alaa fayyadamte jedhamee magaalaa Baqdaaditti qabameera. Namni daldalaa isaanii waliin hidhata cimaa qabu tokkollee yakka wal fakkaatuun qabameera. Hidhaan kun hojii mootummaan malaammaltummaa irratti gaggeessaa jiru keessaa kan maddu yoo ta'u, bara kana keessa qondaaltota gurguddoo hedduutu qaamolee nageenyaan qabame.

title: Wildfires in Albania and Spain cause hundreds to evacuate
english: Severe wildfires are currently burning in both Albania and southern Spain, forcing hundreds of residents to leave their homes for safety. Emergency crews are working extensively to control the flames and prevent further destruction. Authorities are closely monitoring the situation as the fires continue to impact these regions.

title: Ecuador charges ex-minister over presidential candidate assassination case
english: Ecuadorian prosecutors have charged seven individuals, including a former interior minister, for their alleged involvement in the 2023 assassination of presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio. The suspects are accused of having indirect roles in the plot, with many reportedly linked to a powerful criminal gang known as Los Lobos. Authorities have requested international arrest warrants, as most of those charged are currently located outside of Ecuador.
amharic: የኢኳዶር አቃቤ ህግ የቀድሞ የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትርን ጨምሮ ሰባት ግለሰቦች እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 በተገደሉት ፕሬዚዳንታዊ እጩ ፈርናንዶ ቪላቪሴንሲዮ ግድያ እጃቸው አለበት በሚል ክስ መስርቶባቸዋል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ በሴረኛው ድርጊት ቀጥተኛ ያልሆነ ተሳትፎ ነበራቸው የተባለ ሲሆን አብዛኛዎቹም ከሎስ ሎቦስ ከተባለው የወንጀለኞች ቡድን ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳላቸው ታውቋል። ተከሳሾቹ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከሀገር ውጭ በመሆናቸው ባለስልጣናት በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እንዲያዙ ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Ikwadoor, kanneen himataman keessatti ministira dhimma keessa duraanii dabalatee namoota torba irratti himata bananiiru. Himatamaan kunniin gartuu yakka raawwatu kan 'Los Lobos' jedhamu wajjin walqabatu jedhamee kan amaname yoo ta'u, ammaaf biyya alaa waan jiraniif qabamanii akka dhiyaataniif ajajni idil-addunyaa akka ba'u gaafatameera.

title: How Israel’s occupation fuels resistance
english: A persistent cycle of violence continues near Nablus as the Israeli occupation triggers further Palestinian resistance. This ongoing instability resulted in the deaths of five Palestinians while Israel simultaneously expanded its presence by establishing four new outposts. This dynamic of retaliation and occupation remains a core driver of the deepening regional conflict.
amharic: በናብሉስ አቅራቢያ የእስራኤል ወረራ ለፍልስጤማውያን ተቃውሞ መነሳሳት በመስጠቱ የሁከቱ ዑደት ቀጥሏል። በዚህ ግጭት አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ እስራኤልም በአካባቢው አራት አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን በመገንባት ወረራዋን አስፋፍታለች። ይህ የመልስ ምት እና የወረራ ድርጊት በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት ይበልጥ እያባባሰው ይገኛል።
oromo: Naannoo Naabluusitti waraanni Israa'el mormii Falasxiinotaa kakaasuun walitti bu'iinsa itti fufee jiru uumeera. Giddu galeessa kana keessatti Falasxiinonni shan ajjeefamaniiru; Israa'elis gamoo haaraa afur ijaaruun lafa qabachuu ishee itti fufteetti. Haalli wal-irraa hincinne kun waraana fi bu'iinsa naannichaa caalaatti hammaatuuf sababa ta'eera.

title: ‘No surprise’: Netanyahu rejects US-backed Gaza plan
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has turned down a peace proposal for Gaza supported by the United States. Palestinian official Mustafa Barghouti stated that this refusal was expected, noting that Israel has a history of breaking previous agreements. The main question remains whether the U.S. and its Western allies will take any action to hold Israel responsible for its stance.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የፍልስጤሙ ፖለቲከኛ ሙስጠፋ ባርጉቲ እንደተናገሩት እስራኤል ቀደም ሲል የገባቸውን ስምምነቶች በመጣሷ ይህ ውሳኔ አስገራሚ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል። አሁን ያለው ዋና ጥያቄ አሜሪካ እና የምዕራባውያን መንግስታት እስራኤልን ለድርጊቷ ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ ዝግጁ መሆናቸው ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu karoora nagaa Gaazaa kan Ameerikaan deggerame fudhachuu didaniiru. Paolitikichi Paalastinaa Mustafaa Baargutii akka jedhanitti, Israa'el walii galtee kanaan dura turan cabsachaa waan dhufteef diddaan kun kan nama hin dinqne dha. Gaaffiin guddaan amma jiru, Ameerikaanii fi mootummoonni dhihaa Israa'el itti gaafatamummaa akka fudhattu gochuuf tarkaanfii fudhatuu fi dhiisuu isaanii ti.

title: Incumbents secure Hawaii primary wins, defying progressive challengers
english: In the Hawaii Democratic primary, veteran Representative Ed Case successfully defended his seat against progressive challenger Jarrett Keohokalole. While progressives criticized Case for his centrist voting record and corporate funding, his victory demonstrates the resilience of established politicians against newer candidates. Additionally, other Hawaii Democratic leaders, including Representative Jill Tokuda and Governor Josh Green, secured comfortable wins in their respective races.
amharic: በሃዋይ የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ዋና ምርጫ፣ አንጋፋው ተወካይ ኤድ ኬዝ ተፎካካሪያቸውን ጃሬት ኬኦሆካሎሌን በማሸነፍ ቦታቸውን አስጠብቀዋል። ፕሮግረሲቭ አባላት የኬዝን መካከለኛ የፖለቲካ አቋም እና የኮርፖሬት ድጋፍ ቢተቹም፣ ውጤቱ የቆዩ ፖለቲከኞች በአዲስ ፊቶች ላይ ያላቸውን የበላይነት አሳይቷል። እንዲሁም ሌሎች የሃዋይ የዴሞክራቲክ መሪዎች የሆኑት ጂል ቶኩዳ እና ገዥው ጆሽ ግሪን በተመደቡበት ውድድር አሸንፈዋል።
oromo: Filannoo sadarkaa duraa kan Paartii Dimookraatikii Hawaii irratti, bakka bu'aan muuxannoo qaban Ed Case, morkataa isaanii kan ta'an Jarrett Keohokalole injifachuun teessoo isaanii tikfataniiru. Gareen dur-adeemtonni (progressive) ilaalcha siyaasaa Case fi deeggarsa korporeetii isaan argatan irratti mormii kaasanis, injifannoon kun siyaasa keessatti hayyoonni durii humna cimaa akka qaban agarsiiseera. Akkasumas, hoogganoonni biroo kanneen akka Jill Tokuda fi Gootichi Josh Green filannoo isaanii irratti injifannoo salphaa galmeessaniiru.

title: Omar Marmoush scores two goals as Man City defeat Atletico Madrid in Seoul
english: Manchester City secured a 3-1 comeback victory against Atletico Madrid during a preseason friendly held in Seoul. Egyptian striker Omar Marmoush played a pivotal role by scoring two quick goals in the second half to turn the game around. Rayan Ait-Nouri added a final goal in the closing minutes to seal the win for City before their upcoming Community Shield match.

oromo: Manchester City tapha michummaa dura-dursee gaggeeffameen Se’ulitti Atletico Madrid 3-1 mo’ateera. Kaayyoon Gibxii Omar Marmush walakkaa lammaffaatti daqiiqaa sadii keessatti goolii lama lakkoofsisuun injifannoo garee isaa mirkaneesseera. Rayan Ait-Nouri goolii sadaffaa dabaluun taphichi injifannoo Manchester City’n akka xumuramu taasiseera.

title: UAE extradites alleged international crime boss Daniel Kinahan to Ireland
english: The United Arab Emirates has officially extradited alleged international crime kingpin Daniel Kinahan to Ireland to face serious charges. Kinahan, who had been living in Dubai for a decade, is accused of leading a global criminal network involved in drug trafficking, money laundering, and murder. He was transported to Dublin via a government jet and is expected to stand trial at the Special Criminal Court under high security.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ተጠርጣሪውን ዓለም አቀፍ የወንጀል መሪ ዳንኤል ኪናሃንን ለኢርላንድ መንግስት አሳልፎ ሰጥቷል። ለአስር ዓመታት ያህል በዱባይ ሲኖር የቆየው ኪናሃን፣ አደንዛዥ ዕፅን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ማዘዋወርን፣ ገንዘብ ማጠብን እና ግድያን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ከባድ የወንጀል ድርጊቶች ተከሷል። በኢርላንድ መንግስት አውሮፕላን ወደ ደብሊን የተወሰደው ተጠርጣሪው፣ በልዩ የወንጀል ችሎት ቀርቦ ክሱን እንዲከላከል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Emirates Gamtaa Arabaa hoogganaa yakka idil-addunyaa kan ta'e jedhamee shakkamu Daani'eel Kiinaahaan gara Ayirlaandiitti ergeera. Nama waggaa kudhaniif Dubaay keessa jiraachaa ture kun, namoota shakkamoo kanneen yakka darbaa fi daldala seeraan alaa, qarshii seeraan alaa qulqulleessuu fi ajjeechaa raawwataniin himatameera. Daani'eel xiyyaara mootummaatiin gara Dubliin geessamee, seerota cimaa fi eegumsa jabaa jalatti mana murtiitti dhiyaatee falmata jedhamee eegama.

title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 29
english: As the conflict between the US and Iran reaches its 29th day of the second phase, Iran has threatened to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until its specific conditions are satisfied. Meanwhile, regional instability is mounting, with the UAE alleging an Iranian attack on an oil tanker and Houthi forces reporting an assault on a Saudi refinery. These incidents highlight the growing escalation and complexity of the current regional confrontation.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ሁለተኛ ምዕራፍ 29ኛ ቀኑን በያዘበት ወቅት፣ ኢራን ያቀረበችው ጥያቄ እስካልተሟላ ድረስ የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያን እንደምትዘጋ አስታውቃለች። በአንጻሩ የክልሉ ውጥረት እያደገ ሲሄድ፣ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬትስ ኢራን በነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽማለች ስትል ከሰሰች፣ የየመን ሁቲዎች ደግሞ በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጦርነት ሁኔታ ያመለክታሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti adeemsifamaa jiru guyyaa 29ffaa isaa qabateera; yeroo kanatti Iraan fedhiin ishee hanga guutamuutti daandii galaana Hormuz akka cuftee turtu ibsiteetti. Gama biraan, waldhabdeen naannichaa hammaachaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, Emireetiin Arabaa tokko taate Iraan doonii boba'aa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwachuu ishee himatteetti; Hutiin Yemenis qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Sa'udii tokko irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gochootni kunniin waldhabdee naannichaa fi walxaxiinsa haala yeroo ammaa agarsiisu.

title: Pentagon urges faster US weapons production amid stockpile concerns
english: The Pentagon is pressuring defense contractors to significantly increase the speed of weapons production to address concerns over depleted stockpiles. Following intensive use of missile interceptors in the ongoing conflict with Iran, officials have demanded faster delivery schedules from industry leaders within three weeks. Experts warn that these supply shortages could jeopardize the security of U.S. forces and their allies by limiting their ability to effectively intercept incoming threats.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ከኢራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ምክንያት እየቀነሰ የመጣውን የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት ለመሙላት አምራች ኩባንያዎችን የምርት ሂደቱን እንዲያፋጥኑ ጠይቋል። የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ባለስልጣናት የጦር መሳሪያ አቅርቦትን ለማሳደግ እና የረጅም ጊዜ የምርት ሂደቶችን ለማሻሻል አምራች ኩባንያዎች በአስቸኳይ አዳዲስ እቅዶችን እንዲያቀርቡ አሳስበዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት የጦር መሳሪያ እጥረት የአሜሪካን እና የባለቤት አገራትን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ሊጥል እንደሚችል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisa biyyaa Amerikaa, waraana Iraan waliin taasifamuun walqabatee meeshaaleen waraanaa hir'achaa waan jiraniif, dhaabbilee meeshaalee waraanaa oomishan oomisha isaanii ariifachiisan gaafateera. Qondaaltonni kunneen dhaabbileen kunneen oomisha meeshaalee waraanaa daran ariifachiisuuf guyyoota 21 keessatti karoora haaraa akka dhiyeessan ajajaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, hir'inni meeshaalee waraanaa kun humnoota Amerikaa fi biyyoota michoota ishee irratti balaa nageenyaa uumuu danda'a.

title: Iran will defend Strait of Hormuz ‘at any cost’, senior official says
english: A senior Iranian official has declared that the nation is prepared to protect its control over the Strait of Hormuz at any price. Ayatollah Amoli Larijani emphasized that Iran maintains full authority over this vital maritime route, dismissing external efforts to pressure the country. This statement reflects Iran's firm stance regarding its strategic regional interests.
amharic: አንድ ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣን ሀገራቸው በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ላይ ያላትን ቁጥጥር በማንኛውም ዋጋ ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል። አያቶላህ አሞሊ ላሪጃኒ ኢራን በዚህ ስትራቴጂያዊ የውሃ መስመር ላይ ሙሉ ስልጣን እንዳላት በመግለጽ፣ ሀገሪቱን ለመክበብ የሚደረጉ የውጭ ጫናዎችን አጣጥለዋል። ይህ መግለጫ ኢራን ስለ ክልላዊ ጥቅሞቿ ያላትን ጠንካራ አቋም የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz to’annoo isaanii jala jiru bakka hundatti akka ittisan ibsaniiru.
