Ibsi kun fedhii fi murannoo Iraan naannichatti qabdu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: India to Israel and back: How a fake IRGC quote on nuclear weapons reached Netanyahu’s speech
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently quoted an Iranian official claiming that Iran would continue developing nuclear weapons. Investigations revealed that this quote had no verifiable source and actually originated from an anonymous Indian social media account. The false information spread rapidly through pro-government channels and was even amplified by the Prime Minister's son before reaching Netanyahu's own speeches.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ ማዘጋጀቷን እንደምትቀጥል የሚገልጽ የአንድ የኢራን ባለስልጣን ንግግር ጠቅሰው ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ ምርመራዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ይህ ንግግር ምንም አይነት አስተማማኝ ምንጭ የሌለው እና በመጀመሪያ የተሰራጨው ከህንድ በሆነ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ገጽ ነው። ይህ የሀሰት መረጃ በመንግስት ደጋፊ ሚዲያዎች እና በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ልጅ አማካኝነት በፍጥነት በመሰራጨቱ ወደ ኔታንያሁ ንግግር ሊደርስ ችሏል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahu, hoogganaan Iraan tokko meeshaa niwuukilaraa hojjechuu itti fufuuf murteessaniiru jechuun dubbii kijibaa tokko dabarsanii turan. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, dubbiin kun maddii dhugaa kan hin qabneefi jalqaba gadi kan lakkifame fuula miidiyaa hawaasaa Hindii tokko irraayi. Odeeffannoon sobaa kun miidiyaalee mootummaa deggeraniifi ilmi mummicha ministeerichaa akka hirmaatanitti, dafee babal'atee gara haasaa Netaaniyaahuu ga'eera.

title: Concerns mount over integrity of Israel’s upcoming October elections
english: Concerns are growing regarding the fairness and safety of Israel’s October 2026 general election, with many citizens and high-level officials fearing political interference. President Isaac Herzog has publicly warned against civil unrest and urged parties to avoid violence during the campaign period. As Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu seeks another term while facing corruption charges, public anxiety about the state of the country's democracy remains high.
amharic: በእስራኤል በጥቅምት 2026 የሚካሄደው ጠቅላላ ምርጫ ፍትሃዊነት እና ደህንነት አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል፤ ይህም በብዙ ዜጎች እና ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ዘንድ የፖለቲካ ጣልቃገብነት ስጋት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። ፕሬዝዳንት ይስሃቅ ሄርዞግ የሀገሪቱን የውስጥ ሰላም ለመጠበቅ እና የምርጫ ዘመቻው በሰላማዊ መንገድ እንዲከናወን አስጠንቅቀዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በሙስና ክስ እየተጠረጠሩ ለሌላ የስልጣን ዘመን እየተወዳደሩ መሆናቸው በሀገሪቱ ዲሞክራሲ ላይ ያለውን ስጋት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Filannoo biyyaalessaa Israa'el kan gara fuulduraatti gaafa Onkololeessa 2026 geggeeffamuuf jiru ilaalchisee yaaddoon qulqullina fi nageenyaa dabalaa jira. Namoonni hedduu fi qondaaltonni olaanoon, dhiibbaa siyaasaa mudachuu danda'uuf soda qabu. Preezidaant Isaak Heerzoog nageenya biyyattii fi tasgabbii eeguuf, paartileen yeroo duula filannoo kanatti walitti bu'iinsa irraa akka fagaatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Ministirri Muummee Benyaamiin Netanyaanhuu yakka malaammaltummaan himatamaa utuu jiranii aangoo irra turuuf yaaluun isaanii, yaadni waa'ee dimokiraasii biyyattii irratti jiru akka dabalu taasiseera.

title: Gaza’s children still struggling with hunger as another famine threatens
english: Families in Gaza are facing a severe food crisis as humanitarian groups warn that another famine may be imminent. Many children are still recovering from the effects of a previous famine, struggling with health issues caused by long-term malnutrition. While community kitchens provide basic meals, access to essential nutrients remains extremely difficult due to rising prices and restricted supplies.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች ሌላ ረሃብ ሊከሰት እንደሚችል በተሰጠው ማስጠንቀቂያ የተነሳ ከፍተኛ የምግብ እጥረት እየገጠማቸው ነው። ብዙ ህጻናት ባለፈው ዓመት ከደረሰው ረሃብ በኋላ በቂ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ ባለማግኘታቸው የጤና ችግሮች እያጋጠሟቸው ይገኛል። የማህበረሰብ ኩሽናዎች መሰረታዊ ምግቦችን ቢሰጡም፣ የምግብ ዋጋ መናር እና የአቅርቦት እጥረት ለህጻናት አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ንጥረ ነገሮችን ለማግኘት አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Maatiin Gaaza keessa jiraatan hammaataa jiruun rakkoo nyaataa fi beela biraa sodaachisu keessa jiru. Ijoolleen hedduun beela darbe keessatti sababa nyaata dhabuutiin fayyaa isaanii irratti miidhaan ga'e ammas itti fufee jira. Gamtaan mana nyaataa hawaasaa nyaata bu'uuraa dhiyeessan illee, gatiin nyaataa dabaluu fi gargaarsi gahaa ta'e dhabamuun ijoolleen wantoota fayyaaf barbaachisan argachuun akka itti ulfaatu godheera.

title: Gaza engineer builds animal shelters out of empty cans
english: A Palestinian engineer living in Gaza has developed a creative way to help local animals by repurposing discarded metal cans into protective shelters. Through this innovative project, he provides essential housing for creatures struggling to survive in the difficult conditions of the region. His initiative demonstrates how simple recycled materials can be used to improve the welfare of animals amidst ongoing hardships.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖር አንድ መሐንዲስ ባዶ የቆርቆሮ ጣሳዎችን በመጠቀም ለእንስሳት መጠለያ የመስራት ፈጠራን አሳይቷል። ይህ ግለሰብ ችግር ባለበት አካባቢ ለሚገኙ እንስሳት መኖሪያ በመፍጠር አድናቆትን አትርፏል። ፕሮጀክቱ እንደገና ጥቅም ላይ የሚውሉ ቀላል ቁሳቁሶች ለእንስሳት ደህንነት ምን ያህል ፋይዳ እንዳላቸው ያሳያል።
oromo: Injinarri tokko Gaaza keessa jiraatu, qodaa irraanfaa gurguddaa duwwaa ta'an fayyadamudhaan bineensotaaf iddoo qubataa tolchuuf yaada kalaqaa tokko hojiirra oolcheera. Namni kun haala cimaa keessa jiran bineensotaaf bakka jireenyaa qopheessuudhaan gargaarsa taasisaa jira. Hojiin kun meeshaalee gataa ta'an irraa deebisanii fayyadamuun fayidaa bineensotaaf qabu agarsiisa.

title: What now as Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza?
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially rejected a 15-point peace plan proposed by U.S. President Donald Trump for the Gaza Strip. Netanyahu insists that Israeli troops will remain in the region until Hamas is completely stripped of its weapons. While the U.S. plan suggests a gradual withdrawal linked to disarmament, the conflicting demands from both sides continue to stall the peace process.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ለጋዛ ያቀረቡትን የ15 ነጥብ የሰላም ዕቅድ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ኔታንያሁ ሃማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካው ዕቅድ የጦር መሣሪያ ማስፈታትን ከወታደሮች መውጣት ጋር የሚያስተሳስር ቢሆንም፣ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው አለመግባባት የሰላም ሂደቱን አግዶታል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaanhuu karoora nagaa namoota 15 irraa ijaarame kan pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Gaazaaf dhiheessan fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Netanyaanhuun hanga Hamaas guutummaatti meeshaa waraanaa hiikutti waraanni Israa'el Gaazaa keessaa akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Karoorri Ameerikaa meeshaa hiikuu fi waraanni ba'uu wal-faana akka raawwatamu kan yaade ta'us, wal-dhabdeen gidduu lameenii kun adeemsa nagaa sana gufachiisee jira.

title: The Mecca pact is not just another regional alliance
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed a new defense pact in Mecca that signals a strategic shift in Gulf security. Rather than relying solely on the United States, these nations are building a more diverse network of partnerships to ensure their own protection. This agreement reflects a desire for regional self-reliance as these countries prepare for a future where American influence and involvement in the area may become less predictable.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈራረሙት አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የጸጥታ አወቃቀር ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ መጀመሩን ያሳያል። እነዚህ አገራት በአሜሪካ ላይ ብቻ ከመመካት ይልቅ የራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ የተለያዩ አጋርነቶችን እየገነቡ ነው። ይህ ስምምነት የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ መቀነስ ወይም አለመተማመንን በመረዳት፣ ቀጠናዊ አገራት የራሳቸውን የጸጥታ ዋስትና በራሳቸው ለመፍጠር ያላቸውን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkiifi Paakistaan walii galtee ittisa biyyaa haaraa Makkaatti mallatteessan kun naannichatti jijjiirama tarsiimoo tasgabbii fi nageenyaa agarsiisa. Biyyoonni kunneen dhiibbaa fi gargaarsa Ameerikaa irratti qofa hirkachuu mannaa, nageenya isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf michummaa garaagaraa uumuuf tattaaffii godhaa jiru. Walii galteen kun, biyyoonni kunneen jijjiirama gara fuulduraa irratti Ameerikaan naannichatti qabdu hir'achuu danda'uuf of qopheessuuf fi of danda'uuf yaalii gochaa jiran dha.

title: Trump targets birthright citizenship again
english: Former President Donald Trump has issued new executive orders aiming to limit birthright citizenship in the United States. These measures specifically focus on curbing 'birth tourism' and restricting other categories of foreign nationals. This move follows a recent Supreme Court ruling that blocked his previous efforts to change citizenship policies.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ የሚሰጠውን የልደት መብት ዜግነት ለመገደብ አዳዲስ አስፈፃሚ ትዕዛዞችን አውጥተዋል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በተለይ 'የልደት ቱሪዝምን' ለመግታት እና ሌሎች የውጭ ዜጎችን ምድቦች ለመገደብ ያለሙ ናቸው። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱ ቀደም ሲል የዜግነት ህጎችን ለመለወጥ ያደረጉትን ጥረት ውድቅ ካደረገ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantii duraanii Donald Traamp biyya Ameerikaa keessatti mirga lammummaa dhalootaan argamu daangessuuf ajaja haaraa baasaniiru. Tarkaanfiiwwan kun keessattuu 'turizimii dhalootaa' ittisuu fi lammiilee biyya alaa biroo daangessuu irratti xiyyeeffatu. Murtuun kun kan dhufu, mana murtii olaanaan kanaan dura yaalii isaan seera lammummaa jijjiiruuf taasisan mormee erga dide booda dha.

title: Israel’s ‘Green Rafah’ plan aims to fragment Gaza, experts say
english: Israel has initiated a controversial project called 'Green Rafah' in the southern Gaza Strip, which involves building infrastructure for designated housing areas. Analysts argue this plan aims to divide Gaza into small, controlled zones while forcing Palestinians into permanent displacement. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu continues to reject international peace proposals, insisting that military control will remain until Hamas is completely disarmed.
amharic: እስራኤል በደቡባዊ ጋዛ 'ግሪን ራፋህ' የተሰኘ አወዛጋቢ ፕሮጀክት የጀመረች ሲሆን ይህም ለተለዩ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች መሠረተ ልማቶችን መዘርጋትን ያካትታል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ይህ ዕቅድ ጋዛን ወደ ትናንሽ እና ቁጥጥር የሚደረግባቸው ዞኖች በመከፋፈል ፍልስጤማውያንን ለዘላቂ መፈናቀል ለመዳረግ ያለመ ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የሀማስ ትጥቅ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር እንደሚቀጥል በመግለጽ ዓለም አቀፍ የሰላም ዕቅዶችን ውድቅ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Israa'el gammoojjii Gaazaatti 'Green Rafah' kan jedhamu fi mormii guddaa kaase sagantaa haaraa hojiirra oolchite jirti. Sagantaan kun naannolee jireenyaa qopheessuu fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa diriirsuu kan dabalatu yoo ta'u, ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, kun Gaazaa bakka xixiqqootti qoqqooduun ummata Palestiinaa lafarraa buqqisuuf kan karoorfame dha. Muummichi Ministiraa Benyaamiin Netanyaahuu, hamma gareen Haamaas guutummaatti hidhannoo hiikutti to'annoon waraanaa akka itti fufu ibsuun, yaada furmaata nagaa kan biyyoota alaa fudhachuu dideera.

title: British MotoGP: Raul Fernandez dominates at Silverstone to beat Martin
english: Raul Fernandez secured a dominant victory at the British MotoGP after taking the lead on the first lap and maintaining his pace throughout the race. Championship leader Jorge Martin finished in second place despite suffering a mechanical issue at the start, which helped him extend his overall lead in the standings. Marco Bezzecchi completed the podium in third, marking a successful return to form at the Silverstone circuit.
amharic: ራውል ፈርናንዴዝ በእንግሊዝ የሞቶጂፒ ውድድር ከመጀመሪያው ዙር አንስቶ መሪነቱን በመውሰድ አሸናፊ ሆኗል። የውድድሩ መሪ ጆርጅ ማርቲን በጅማሬ ላይ ባጋጠመው የቴክኒክ ችግር ምክንያት ሁለተኛ ቢወጣም፣ በጠቅላላ የደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ የነበረውን የበላይነት ለማስፋት ችሏል። ማርኮ ቤዜቺ ሶስተኛ በመውጣት የሜዳሊያ ባለቤት ሆኗል።
oromo: Raul Fernandez dorgommii British MotoGP irratti jalqaba irraa kaasee dursuun injifannoo gonfateera. Hogganaan dorgommichaa Jorge Martin, jalqaba irratti rakkoo tekinikaa mudateen booda sadarkaa lammaffaa irratti xumurus, sadarkaa waliigalaa irratti qabxii isaa guddisuu danda'eera. Marco Bezzecchi sadarkaa sadaffaa irratti xumuruun injifannoo isaa mirkaneeffateera.

title: Houthi attacks kill 11 in Yemen and target Saudi refinery
english: Houthi militants launched drone and missile attacks that killed 11 people and injured 32 others in the Yemeni city of Mokha. This aggression also targeted an oil refinery in Saudi Arabia, escalating tensions as the existing truce between warring factions continues to crumble. The group claims these assaults are a retaliation for Saudi military involvement in Yemen.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ሞካ ከተማ በወሰዱት የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት 11 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 32 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የሳዑዲ አረቢያን የነዳጅ ማጣሪያም ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል የነበረው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መፍረሱንም ያሳያል። ታጣቂ ቡድኑ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው በየመን ጉዳይ ላይ ለሚታየው የሳዑዲ ጣልቃ ገብነት አጸፋዊ ምላሽ ለመስጠት መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Finniinsaalee Huthotaan magaalaa Mokhaatti miilishonni gaggeessaniin namoonni 11 ajjeefamanii 32 ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Sa'udii irrattis kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, kunis walii galtee tasgabbii biyyattii gidduutti ture akka diigame mirkaneessa. Gareen Huthotaa akka jedhetti, haleellaan kun tarkaanfii waraana Sa'udii biyyattiitti fudhateef haaloo bahuuf kan gaggeeffame dha.

title: Why does Iran defeat the empires trying to conquer it?
english: The latest episode of the Al Jazeera podcast series Deja Vu explores Iran’s history of successfully resisting various imperial powers throughout the centuries. By examining past conflicts with nations like Russia and Britain, the program analyzes how these external attempts at control have paradoxically shaped modern Iran. Historian Dr. Mehran Kamrava discusses why foreign powers repeatedly miscalculate when trying to dominate the region.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ የፖድካስት ፕሮግራም ‘ዴጃቩ’ አዲሱ ክፍል ኢራን በታሪክ ውስጥ የተለያዩ የዓለም ኃያላን መንግስታትን ተጽዕኖ እንዴት መቋቋም እንደቻለች ይዳስሳል። ፕሮግራሙ እንደ ሩሲያ እና ብሪታንያ ካሉ ሀገራት ጋር የነበሩትን ግጭቶች በመመርመር፣ የውጭ ጣልቃገብነቶች ዘመናዊቷን ኢራን እንዴት እንደቀረጿት ያብራራል። የታሪክ ምሁሩ ዶክተር ሜህራን ካምራቫ፣ ኃያላን ሀገራት ኢራንን ለመቆጣጠር በሚያደርጉት ጥረት ለምን በተደጋጋሚ እንደሚሳሳቱ ይተነትናሉ።
oromo: Sagantaan podkaastii Al-Jazeera 'Deja Vu' jedhamu inni haaraan, seenaa biyyoota gurguddoon akka Iran itti dhiibbaa alaa mo'achaa turte irratti xiyyeeffata. Walitti dhufeenya fi wal-dorgommii biyyoota akka Ruusiyaafi Biriiteen waliin qabdu irraa ka'uudhaan, yaaliin biyyoota alaa Iran to'achuuf godhan akkamitti akka Iran ammayyaatti akka geesse ibsa. Hayyuun seenaa Dr. Mehran Kamrava, maaliif mootummoonni gurguddoon Iran to'achuuf yaalanii dogoggora wal-fakkaatu irra deddeebi'anii akka raawwatan ni ibsu.

title: Barzani says Iraqi Kurdistan wants peace as regional tensions rise
english: Masrour Barzani, the Prime Minister of the Kurdistan Regional Government, has stated that his region remains committed to maintaining peace and avoiding involvement in broader Middle Eastern conflicts. Despite facing frequent attacks during the period of US-Iran regional tensions, he emphasized a desire to prioritize regional stability. He continues to advocate for peaceful diplomatic resolutions to protect the security of Iraqi Kurdistan.
amharic: የኩርዲስታን ክልላዊ መንግስት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማስሩር ባርዛኒ፣ ክልላቸው ሰላምን ለመጠበቅ እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ከሚከሰቱ ግጭቶች ራሱን ለማግለል ቁርጠኛ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በነበረው ውጥረት ወቅት ክልሉ በተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት ቢደርስበትም፣ እርሳቸው ግን የክልሉን መረጋጋት ለማስቀደም እንደሚሰሩ ተናግረዋል። የኩርዲስታንን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅም በዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና በሰላማዊ መንገዶች መፍትሄ መፈለግ እንደሚገባ አስምረውበታል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Mootummaa Naannoo Kurdistaan Masruur Baarzaanii, naannoon isaanii nagaa eeggachuu fi walitti buiinsa naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti mul'atu irraa of qusachuuf murteeffataniiru jedhan. Yeroo walitti buiinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan keessatti naannichi isaanii yeroo baayyee miidhaa keessa kan ture ta'us, inni garuu tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf akka carraaqan ibsaniiru. nageenya Kurdistaan Iraaqiif jecha rakkoolee karaa nagaa fi dippilomaasii hiikuu akka barbaadan dubbataniiru.

title: ‘The wealthy poor’: Soaring food prices hurt Iranian families
english: Iranian families are facing a severe economic crisis as food inflation has surged over 100 percent, making basic necessities unaffordable for many. The combination of currency devaluation, regional conflicts, and naval blockades has caused grocery prices to double, forcing even middle-class households to cut back on essential items like meat and high-quality rice. Many citizens now find that their entire salaries are insufficient to cover basic monthly food expenses.
amharic: የኢራን ቤተሰቦች የምግብ ዋጋ ከ100 በመቶ በላይ በመጨመሩ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የገንዘብ ዋጋ መቀነስ፣ የክልላዊ ግጭቶች እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎች የምግብ ዋጋ እንዲያሻቅብ በማድረጋቸው፣ መካከለኛ ገቢ ያላቸው ሰዎች እንኳን እንደ ስጋ እና ሩዝ ያሉ መሰረታዊ ነገሮችን ለመግዛት ተቸግረዋል። አብዛኛዎቹ ዜጎች ወርሃዊ ደመወዛቸው ለቤተሰብ የምግብ ፍጆታ እንኳን እንደማያበቃ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Maatiiwwan Iraan keessa jiraatan gatii midhaan nyaataa dhibbeentaa 100 ol dabaleen walqabatee rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa jiru. Gatiin qarshii hir’achuu, waraana naannichaa fi uggurri markabaa gatiin nyaataa akka dachaan dabalu waan godheef, namoonni giddu-galeessa waggaailleen illee akka foonii fi ruuzii jiran bitachuu dadhabaniiru. Hojjettoota baay’ee biratti, mindaan isaanii baatii tokkoof kan ta’u nyaata bituuf illee gahaa miti.

title: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Sicily coast
english: Italian authorities have discovered a well-preserved ancient Roman shipwreck off the coast of Sicily, dating back over 2,000 years. Found by divers following a tip from a local fisherman, the vessel contains hundreds of ceramic jars that were originally used to transport goods like wine and olive oil. Experts from the Italian police are now securing the site to conduct further research on this significant historical find.
amharic: የጣሊያን ባለስልጣናት ከሲሲሊ የባህር ዳርቻ በቅርቡ ከ2,000 ዓመታት በላይ ያስቆጠረ የጥንታዊ ሮማውያን መርከብ ፍርስራሽ አግኝተዋል። በአካባቢው አጥማጅ ጥቆማ የተገኙት ጠላቂዎች፣ መርከቧ የወይን ጠጅ እና የወይራ ዘይት ለማጓጓዝ ያገለግሉ በነበሩ በመቶዎች በሚቆጠሩ የሸክላ ዕቃዎች የተሞላ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። የጣሊያን ፖሊስ ባለሙያዎች ይህንን ታሪካዊ ግኝት ለመጠበቅ እና ተጨማሪ ጥናት ለማድረግ ስፍራውን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Xaaliyaan qarqara galaana Sisilii keessatti doonii durii Roomaa waggaa 2,000 ol lakkoofsise argataniiru. Qonnaan bultoota fiilmii irraa odeeffannoo argatanii booda, duuboo (divers) dooniin kun gaallaaleen wayinii fi zayitaa zayitii fe'achuuf gargaaran hedduun akka keessa jiran hubataniiru. Poolisiin Xaaliyaan qabeenya seena qabeessa kana eeguufi qorannoo dabalataa gaggeessuuf iddoo sana to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Netanyahu rejects Trump’s Board of Peace plan for Gaza
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially turned down Donald Trump’s proposal for a Gaza peace initiative. He stated that the Israeli military will not leave the region until Hamas has been completely disarmed. Netanyahu emphasized that the suggestions provided by the United States are currently not acceptable to his government.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የዶናልድ ትራምፕን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ በይፋ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ሀማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቀዋል። ኔታንያሁ አክለውም አሜሪካ ያቀረበችው ሀሳብ በእስራኤል መንግስት ዘንድ ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuu karoora nageenyaa Gaazaaf Doonaald Tiraamp dhiyeessan fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Humnoonni Israa'el gareen Hamaas guutummaatti meeshaa hiikkachuu hanga mirkaneessanitti naannichaa gadhiisanii akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Netanyaahuun yaadonni Ameerikaan dhiyeessite mootummaa isaanii biratti kan hin fudhatamne ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Indonesia closes national park in East Java as wildfire expands
english: Indonesian authorities have completely shut down access to the Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park due to a rapidly spreading wildfire. Hundreds of personnel, supported by helicopters and drones, are working to control the blaze, which has affected 176 hectares of land. The park remains closed indefinitely to ensure public safety as officials battle difficult terrain and strong winds made worse by an intense dry season.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ በብሮሞ ተንገር ሴሜሩ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ የተቀሰቀሰው የእሳት ቃጠሎ በፍጥነት በመስፋፋቱ ባለስልጣናት ፓርኩን ሙሉ ለሙሉ ዘግተዋል። እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ አባላት በሄሊኮፕተሮች እና በድሮኖች ታግዘው እየሰሩ ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን ወደ 176 ሄክታር የሚጠጋ መሬት ወድሟል። በደረቅ የአየር ጠባይ እና በችግር በተሞላው መልክዓ ምድር ምክንያት የእሳት አደጋ መቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ ፓርኩ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ዝግ ሆኖ ይቆያል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni mootummaa Indoneeziyaa bosonni Bromo Tengger Semeru bifa ariifachiisaa ta'een waan gubachaa jiruuf, daawwattootaaf cufameera. Iddoo kana dhaamsuuf namoonni dhibbaan lakkaawwaman xiyyaara xiqqa (drones) fi helikoptara fayyadamuun tattaaffii godhaa jiranis, lafti hektaara 176 ta'u gubateera. Haalli qilleensa goginsaa fi lafti bakka sanaa tulluu fi dhangala'aa ta'uun isaa hojii dhaamsaa sanatti cimee itti fufee jiraachuu isaa hordofee, iddoon kun hanga beeksisni biraa kennamutti cufamee tura.

title: Israel rejects Donald Trump’s Gaza Board of Peace plan
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has turned down Donald Trump's proposed 15-point peace initiative for the Gaza Strip. Netanyahu stated that Israel will maintain its military presence and continue operations until Hamas is completely disarmed. The government maintains that these actions are necessary to ensure the safety of its citizens and military personnel.

english: The Nigerian government is currently hosting mass wedding ceremonies to assist citizens with limited financial means. By organizing these group events, authorities are making it more affordable for low-income couples to start their lives together.

title: Houthi attacks in Yemen kill four government troops, say sources
english: Houthi forces launched attacks on government positions along Yemen's Red Sea coast this Sunday, resulting in the deaths of at least four soldiers. According to military sources, approximately 20 additional personnel sustained injuries during the strikes in the areas of Mokha and Khokha. The Houthi group confirmed they targeted military equipment and personnel in the region.

english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian held a meeting with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei in late July to discuss the nation's military and economic strategies. title: Hundreds forced onto Rome streets amid crackdown on squatted building
english: Around 300 people in Rome have been displaced and are now living on the streets following a government raid on a large squatted building known as Spin Time Labs. Authorities reclaimed the property after a fire occurred there, as part of a broader crackdown on long-standing, self-managed social centers. These residents are facing this forced eviction while dealing with an intense heatwave in the city.

oromo: Magaalaa Roomaa keessatti namoonni 300 ta'an erga mana 'Spin Time Labs' jedhamu kan seeraan ala qabamee ture mootummaan fudhateen booda daandii irra buufataniiru. Qondaalonni mootummaa haala nageenyaa fi ibidda naannichatti ka'een walqabatee, wiirtuulee hawaasaa ofiin bulan kana cufuuf tarkaanfii fudhataniiru. Namoonni kun amma yeroo obomboleettiin (heatwave) cimaan magaalaa sanatti mudate keessatti bakka buufatan dhabanii rakkatanii jiru.

title: Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has formally rejected a 15-point peace proposal for Gaza supported by Hamas. He insisted that the Israeli military will maintain its presence in the region and refuse to withdraw until Hamas is completely disarmed. Despite previous ceasefire agreements, Israeli forces continue to conduct regular operations within the Gaza Strip.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ሃማስን የሚደግፈውን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ በይፋ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። እስራኤል ሃማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ እንደማታስወጣ አስታውቀዋል። ቀደም ሲል ከተደረጉ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ቢኖርም የእስራኤል ጦር በጋዛ ሰርጥ ላይ ጥቃቱን አጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahuu karoora nageenyaa Gaazaaf dhiyaatee fi gareen Hamaas deggerame fudhatama dhabsiiseera. Hamaas hanga guutummaatti meeshaa hiikkatuutti waraanni Israa'el naannichaa akka hin gadhiisne ibseera. Waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa dura taasisamee ture jiraatus, waraanni Israa'el naannoo Gaazaatti haleellaa geggeessuu itti fufeera.

title: Saudi Aramco refinery erupts in flames in Jizan as Houthis claim drone attack
english: A fire broke out at a Saudi Aramco oil refinery in the city of Jizan on Sunday, which authorities successfully extinguished without any reported injuries. While officials did not specify the cause, the Houthi movement in Yemen claimed responsibility, stating they targeted the site with a drone in retaliation for border violations. This incident highlights ongoing regional tensions as Houthi forces continue to strike Saudi energy infrastructure amid intensifying conflict in Yemen.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ ጂዛን ከተማ በሚገኝ የሳውዲ አራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያ እሁድ ዕለት የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቶ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ጉዳት ሳይደርስ እሳቱን ማጥፋታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት የእሳቱ መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ በግልፅ ባይናገሩም፣ በየመን የሚገኙት የሁቲ አማፂያን ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት እነሱ መሆናቸውን እና የሳውዲ ድንበር ጥሰትን ለመበቀል ድሮን መጠቀማቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በየመን እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት መሀል የሁቲ ኃይሎች በሳውዲ የኢነርጂ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃታቸውን መቀጠላቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa Jizanitti bakka buufata ramadan Saudi Aramco keessatti ibidda ka’een miidhaan lubbuu hin qaqqabne, hoggantoonnis dafanii dhaamsuu danda’aniiru. Mootummaan sababa ibiddaa ifa gochuun baatus, gareen Houthii kan Yaman turan xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) fayyadamuun iddoo sana haleeluu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame duula daangaa Saudi Arabiyaan gaggeessiteen walqabatee akka ta'e gareen sun ibseera. Kuni waraana Yaman keessatti hammaachaa jiru keessatti, gareen Houthii buufataalee inarjii Saudi Arabiyaa irratti haleellaa geggeessaa jiraachuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Netanyahu says Iran will 'not have nuclear weapons' with or without deal
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has vowed to block Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons. He declared that this policy remains in effect regardless of any international deals or negotiations involving Washington. Netanyahu emphasized that preventing a nuclear-armed Iran is his top priority while he remains in office.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ኢራን የኑክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል ቆርጠው መነሳታቸውን አስታወቁ። ከዋሽንግተን ወይም ከሌሎች አካላት ጋር በሚደረጉ የድርድር ሂደቶች ላይ ሳይመሰረቱ ይህንን ግብ እንደሚያሳኩ ገልጸዋል። በስልጣን ላይ እስካሉ ድረስ ኢራን የኑክሌር ኃይል እንዳትሆን ማንኛውንም እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun, Iraan meeshaa niukilaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaanii ibsan. Dhimmi kun haala marii biyyoota biraa waliin jiruun ala akka raawwatamu hubachiisaniiru. Isaan aangoo irra jiran hanga ta'etti, Iraan meeshaa niukilaraa akka hin qabaanne gochuun dirqama isaanii ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Iran to release footage of Mojtaba Khamenei in the future, says report
english: A senior Iranian official announced that upcoming video footage will show Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei attending public events and meeting with military leaders. This move is intended to address rumors surrounding his health following his absence from public view since taking office. There has been widespread speculation that he sustained serious injuries during the recent attack that resulted in his father's death.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን እንደገለጹት፣ ጠቅላይ መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ በሕዝብ መካከል እና ከወታደራዊ አዛዦች ጋር ሲገናኙ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በቅርቡ ይፋ ይደረጋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በሥልጣን ላይ ከቆዩበት ጊዜ አንስቶ በይፋ አለመታየታቸውን ተከትሎ ለተነሱት የጤንነት ሁኔታ ስጋቶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። አባታቸው በተገደሉበት ጥቃት እርሳቸውም ለከባድ ጉዳት ተዳርገዋል የሚሉ ግምቶች እየተሰራጩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iiraan akka ibsanitti, dura ta'aan biyyattii Mojtaabaa Kaameeneen hawaasa waliin ykn abbootii waraanaa waliin yeroo wal argu agarsiisuuf viidiyoon qophaa'aa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, erga aangoo qabatanii as ifatti waan hin mul'anneef waa'ee fayyummaasaanii irratti shakkii uumamee ture deebisuufi. Isaanis haleellaa abbaansaanii itti du'an sana keessatti miidhaan qaamaa cimaan irra ga'eera jedhamee shakkamaa ture.

title: Russian forces kill several in Ukraine, launch ‘brutal’ attack in Odesa
english: Russian forces launched a widespread series of attacks across Ukraine, resulting in multiple deaths and injuries, including a deadly drone strike on an apartment building in Kharkiv. The campaign also targeted port infrastructure in Odesa, which President Zelenskyy condemned as a deliberate effort to threaten global food security. Meanwhile, Russian officials reported that Ukrainian drone strikes resulted in three civilian fatalities in the Belgorod border region.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዩክሬን በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ባደረሱት መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል እንዲሁም ቆስለዋል። በካርኪቭ ከተማ የመኖሪያ ሕንጻ ላይ በደረሰው የድሮን ጥቃት የሰው ሕይወት ሲጠፋ፣ በኦዴሳ ወደብ ላይ ያነጣጠረው ጥቃትም ዓለም አቀፍ የምግብ ዋስትናን የሚፈታተን እንደሆነ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት በቤልጎሮድ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በደረሰ የዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃት ሶስት ሲቪሎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa guutuu Yukreeniitti haleellaa bal'aa gaggeessaniin lubbuun namootaa darbee miiidhaan gahuu isaa gabaafameera. Haleellaa dhiheenya Kaarkiv keessatti iddoo jireenyaarratti dhufeen namoota du'anii fi madaa'an booda, haleellaa buufata Oodeesaa irratti gaggeeffameen Prezidaanti Zeelenskiin nageenya nyaataa addunyaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, aanga'oonni Raashiyaa haleellaa xiyyaara raadaara hin qabneen (drone) daangaa Belgoroditti namoonni sadii du'uu isaanii beeksisaniiru.

title: Yemeni army warns Houthis after attacks heighten escalation risk
english: The Yemeni government has officially warned the Houthi movement that it will launch military strikes in response to recent aggression. This decision follows accusations that the Iran-supported group has intensified its attacks on government military installations. These events mark a significant rise in tensions, increasing the risk of further conflict in the region.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት በቅርቡ በወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ የደረሰውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ በሁቲ አማጺያን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል። መንግሥት የኢራን ድጋፍ ያላቸው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃቱን በማጠናከር ሁኔታውን ወደ ለየለት ግጭት እየገፉት እንደሆነ ይከሳል። ይህ የሁለቱ ወገኖች ግጭት በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት የበለጠ እንደሚያባብሰው ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen, gareen Houthii dirree waraanaatti haleellaa raawwachaa jiraachuu isaatiin walqabatee tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf akka qophaa'e akeekkachiiseera. Mootummaan kun garee Iran deeggartootaa ta'e kana haleellaa babal'isuu keessatti himateera. Haaloonni kunis waldhabdeen biyyattii keessaa akka daran hammatu fi nageenyi naannichaa akka sodaachisu taasiseera.

title: Houthis say they targeted 'Saudi enemy' forces and equipment in Yemen
english: Houthi forces in Yemen announced they launched a significant military attack against Saudi troops and military equipment near the Red Sea city of Mokha. The group claims to have utilized a combination of drones and ballistic missiles for this operation. Local residents reported hearing explosions in the area following the strike.
amharic: በየመን የሚገኙት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ በምትገኘው የሞካ ከተማ በሳውዲ ወታደሮች እና መሳሪያዎች ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው በበርካታ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖች እና በባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎች አማካኝነት መሆኑን ገልጿል። በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎችም ፍንዳታዎች መሰማታቸውን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin Yemen jiru, magaalota qarqara Galaana Diimaa kan taate Mokha keessatti waraana Saudii fi meeshaan waraanaa irratti haleellaa guddaa raawwachuu isaa beeksise. Gareen kun haleellaa kanaaf boombiiwwan balistikiifi xiyyoottan nama hin feene fayyadamuu isaa ibseera. Jiraattonni naannichaa haleellaa sana booda sagalee dhooyinsa guddaa dhaga'uu isaanii himaniiru.

title: Palestinians in occupied West Bank hold firm on Indigenous Peoples’ Day
english: Residents of the Palestinian village of Umm al-Khair are facing ongoing harassment, land encroachment, and military incursions by Israeli settlers. Despite these pressures, the community is attempting to maintain their cultural traditions, such as weddings, while mourning the death of a local activist. Villagers report that settlers, often supported by military presence, are actively working to displace them from their ancestral lands.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የምትገኘው የኡም አል-ኻይር መንደር ነዋሪዎች በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች እና በወታደሮች እየደረሰባቸው ባለው ጫና፣ የድንበር መጣስ እና የግዳጅ መፈናቀል ስጋት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ማህበረሰቡ የአካባቢው አክቲቪስት ህልፈትን እያሰቡ በባህላዊ ስነስርዓታቸው ለመቀጠል ቢሞክሩም፣ ሰፋሪዎች ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እያገኙ የመሬት ወረራ እና የተለያዩ ጥቃቶችን እየፈፀሙባቸው ነው። ይህም የሰዎቹን የአኗኗር ዘይቤ እና ደህንነት ለከፍተኛ አደጋ አጋልጦታል።
oromo: Namoonni ganda Umm al-Khair kan West Bank keessatti argamu, miidhaa fi balleessaa qonnaan bultoota Israa'el akkasumas duula waraanaatiin qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'uuf sodaa cimaa keessa jiru. Hawaasichi kabaja du'a hogganaa isaanii gaddaa jiruu fi sirnoota aadaa isaanii eeggachuu yaalaa yoo ta'u, qonnaan bultoonni Israa'el gargaarsa waraanaan lafa isaanii weerachuu fi jireenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa uumuu itti fufaniiru. Gochi kun hawaasicha tasgabbii dhabsiisuu fi lafa isaanii irraa isaan ari'uuf kan yaadame dha.

title: FIFA decries ‘concerted’ effort to undermine Infantino as crisis deepens
english: FIFA has issued a statement condemning coordinated attempts to discredit President Gianni Infantino following recent controversies. These tensions escalated after the failure of his proposal to sell commercial rights for major tournaments and allegations regarding his past conduct at UEFA. The organization maintains that Infantino retains the support of its members and insists that any leadership challenges must follow official democratic procedures.
amharic: ፊፋ የፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖን ስም ለማጠልሸት የተቀናጀ ጥረት እየተደረገ ነው ሲል በሰጠው መግለጫ አስታውቋል። ይህ ውጥረት የተፈጠረው የዓለም ዋንጫ የንግድ መብቶችን ለመሸጥ የቀረበው ዕቅድ በመክሸፉ እና ከዚህ ቀደም በUEFA ውስጥ በነበሩበት ወቅት የተነሱ ክሶችን ተከትሎ ነው። ፊፋ የፕሬዝዳንቱን አመራር ለመቃወም የሚፈልጉ አካላት በድርጅቱ ህግና ዲሞክራሲያዊ አሰራር መሰረት ብቻ መጓዝ እንዳለባቸው አሳስቧል።
oromo: FIFA pirezidaantii isaanii Jaanii Infaantinoo irratti duula qindaa’aa ta’e gaggeeffamaa akka jiru ibseera. Kunu kan dhufe karoora isaan taphoota gurguddoo irratti mirga daldalaa gurguruuf qaban erga fashaleen booda fi himata waa’ee darbee isaanii irraa kan ka’edha. FIFA akka jedhutti, inni ammas deggertoota isaanii kan qabu yoo ta’u, jijjiiramni kamiyyuu akka seeraa fi sirna demokraasii isaanii kan eeggate ta’uu qaba jedheera.

title: Morocco, Algeria reach WAFCON semifinals and qualify for FIFA World Cup
english: Morocco and Algeria have secured their spots in the WAFCON semifinals after winning their respective quarterfinal matches. By reaching the final four, both nations have also made history by becoming the first African teams to qualify for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil. Morocco defeated South Africa, while Algeria staged a comeback victory against the Ivory Coast following a crucial red card.
amharic: ሞሮኮ እና አልጄሪያ በየራሳቸው የሩብ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታዎች በማሸነፍ ወደ ዋፍኮን (WAFCON) ግማሽ ፍጻሜ አልፈዋል። አራቱ ውስጥ በመግባታቸውም በብራዚል ለሚዘጋጀው የ2027 የሴቶች ዓለም ዋንጫ የተመረጡ የመጀመሪያዎቹ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ሆነዋል። ሞሮኮ ደቡብ አፍሪካን ስታሸንፍ፣ አልጄሪያ ደግሞ ተጋጣሚዋ በቀይ ካርድ ከተቀጣች በኋላ መሪነቱን በመቀልበስ ድል ቀናዋታል።
oromo: Morookoo fi Aljeeriyaan tapha raaba xumuraa injifachuun gara gidduu xumuraa dorgommii Waafkoon (WAFCON) dabiraniiru. Gareen lamaanuu gara gidduu xumuraa kan gahan yoo ta'u, biyyoota Afrikaa tapha waancaa addunyaa dubartootaa bara 2027 kan Biraaziilitti gaggeeffamuuf darban jalqabaa ta'aniiru. Morookoon biyya Afrikaa Kibbaa injifatte yoo ta'u, Aljeeriyaan ammoo erga morkattuun ishee kaardii diimaan ergamtee booda taphicha injifachuun milkoofteetti.

title: Why is Pezeshkian urging an end to Iran’s ‘no war, no peace’ status?
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is seeking to end the current stalemate between his country and the United States, describing the present as the ideal time for a lasting agreement. As part of these efforts, Iran is engaged in indirect talks via Oman to potentially reopen the critical Strait of Hormuz, which has been blocked since the conflict began in February. While Tehran maintains that it is not negotiating directly with Washington, officials are working through intermediaries to address past agreement violations and resolve the ongoing crisis.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ መዘሽኪያን በአገራቸው እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን የውዝግብ ሁኔታ ለማብቃት ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህንን ውጥረት ለመፍታት እና ቀጣይነት ያለው ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ አሁን ትክክለኛው ጊዜ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በኦማን አማካይነት እየተደረጉ ባሉ ውይይቶች፣ ከየካቲት ወር ጀምሮ ተዘግቶ የቆየውን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ እንደገና ለመክፈት እና የቀድሞ ስምምነቶችን መጣስ ተከትሎ የተፈጠሩ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት እየተሰራ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan, biyyi isaanii fi Ameerikaan gidduutti haalli jiru 'lolaa fi nagaa dhabuu' keessa akka hin turre barbaadu. Yeroon ammaa kun waliigaltee dhimma cimaa furuuf gaarii akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Hanga ammaa karaa biyya Omaan marii taasifamaa jiruun, walitti bu'iinsa ji'a Guraandhalaa eegaleen cufamee kan ture daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz banuuf yaaliin godhamaa jira.

title: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
english: Fifa has rejected accusations regarding President Gianni Infantino's personal life, labeling the claims as false and part of a coordinated attempt to weaken his leadership. This backlash occurs amidst growing tension with European football associations, who have expressed a lack of confidence in Infantino following a controversial proposal to privatize commercial rights. Despite calls for his resignation and threats of boycotts, Fifa maintains that its president holds a legitimate democratic mandate and warned critics against using misinformation to force a change in leadership.
amharic: ፊፋ ስለ ፕሬዝዳንቱ  Gianni Infantino የግል ሕይወት የቀረቡትን ክሶች ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የድርጅቱን አመራር ለማዳከም የታቀዱ የተሳሳቱ መረጃዎች ናቸው ሲል ገልጿል። ይህ ውዝግብ የተፈጠረው የፊፋን የንግድ መብቶች በግል ኩባንያ ስር ለማድረግ በቀረበው አወዛጋቢ እቅድ ምክንያት በአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበራት እና በፊፋ መካከል በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ነው። የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት በዲሞክራሲያዊ መንገድ የተመረጡ በመሆናቸው ስልጣናቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ የገለጸው ድርጅቱ፣ ተቃዋሚዎች መሰረተ ቢስ ክሶችን በመጠቀም አመራሩን ለመለወጥ የሚደረገውን ጥረት አውግዟል።
oromo: FIFA himata jireenya dhuunfaa pirezidaantii isaanii Gianni Infantino irratti dhiyaate kan mormu ta'uu ibsee, himanni kun hogganummaa isaa laaffisuuf yaadamee kan dhiyaate oduu sobaa ta'uu beeksiseera. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan uumame erga FIFA mirga daldalaa isaa dhaabbata dhuunfaatti dabarsuuf yaadee booda, gamtaan kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa amanannaa isaa dhabuu isaa ibsee booda. Pirezidaantiin FIFA karaa dimokiraatawaa ta'een waan filamaniif aangoo isaanii akka itti fufan kan ibse FIFA, mormitoonni soba fi himata sobaan hogganummaa jijjiiruuf yaaluun isaanii sirrii akka hin taane hubachiiseera.

title: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan returning to Ireland in high-security operation
english: Daniel Kinahan, a suspected leader of a major organized crime group, is being extradited from Dubai to Ireland under high security. He is set to face charges in the Special Criminal Court for directing a criminal organization following his arrest in the UAE earlier this year. Irish authorities have implemented significant security measures for his transport and detention to manage the risks associated with his high-profile case.
amharic: የተደራጀ የወንጀል ቡድን መሪ ነው ተብሎ የሚጠረጠረው ዳንኤል ኪናሃን ከዱባይ ወደ አየርላንድ በከፍተኛ ጥበቃ እየተመለሰ ነው። በኤሚሬቶች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋለው ኪናሃን፣ የወንጀል ድርጅትን በመምራት ክስ ቀርቦበት ወደ አየርላንድ ለፍርድ እየቀረበ ነው። የአየርላንድ መንግስት በጉዳዩ ላይ ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ጥበቃ በማድረግ ተጠርጣሪውን ወደ እስር ቤት ለማዛወር ዝግጅቱን አጠናቋል።
oromo: Hoggansa garee yakka gurmaa'e kan ta'e jedhamee kan shakkamu Daani'eel Kiinaahaan, eegumsa cimaa jala ta'ee Dubaay irraa gara Ayirlaandiitti deebi'aa jira. Namichi kun erga Emiireetota Arabaatti to'annoo jala oolee booda, dhaabbata yakkaa hogganuun himatamee mana murtiitti dhiyaachuuf dirqameera. Mootummaan Ayirlaandi nageenya isaa eeguuf fi gara mana hidhaatti geessuuf sochii eegumsa cimaa ta'e taasisaa jira.

title: State of emergency declared as fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in British Columbia, Canada, has triggered a state of emergency after doubling in size and forcing over 20,000 residents to evacuate. Officials described the blaze as incredibly intense and destructive, causing the loss of homes and requiring urgent rescue efforts for trapped individuals. The provincial government has implemented emergency measures to manage resources, restrict travel, and assist in the widespread evacuation of affected communities.
amharic: በካናዳ ብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ግዛት የተከሰተ ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ በፍጥነት በመስፋፋቱ ከ20,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች ቤታቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። እሳቱ መጠኑ በእጥፍ በማደጉ እና ከፍተኛ ውድመት በማድረሱ የክልሉ መንግስት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ማወጁን ገልጿል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱ እጅግ አደገኛ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ የተጎዱ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ እና ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር የተለያዩ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kanadaa, British Columbia keessatti ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'achaa jiruun lammiilee 20,000 ol ta'an manasaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ibidnichi dachaa ta'ee guddachuu isaa fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa hordofee, mootummaan naannichaa labsiin yeroo ariifachiisaa akka labsamu taasiseera. Aangoon kun rakkoo kana to'achuuf, carraaqqii lubbuu baraaruu irratti akka bobba'an fi sochii namootaa irratti uggura akka godhan gargaara.

title: From autonomy to 'settler colonialism': How India redrew Kashmir's demographic and political landscape
english: Seven years after India removed the special constitutional status of Kashmir in 2019, the region has undergone significant political and demographic changes under direct rule from New Delhi. New laws have allowed outsiders to obtain residency and purchase land, leading to concerns among locals about the erosion of their rights and increasing economic inequality. While the government claims these policies promote development and integration, residents argue that these measures are systematically disenfranchising the native population.
amharic: ህንድ በ2019 የካሽሚርን ልዩ ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብት ከሰረዘች በኋላ፣ ክልሉ በኒው ዴልሂ ቀጥተኛ አስተዳደር ስር ትልቅ የፖለቲካ እና የህዝብ ቁጥር ለውጦችን አስተናግዷል። የወጡ አዳዲስ ህጎች ከክልሉ ውጭ ያሉ ሰዎች ነዋሪ እንዲሆኑ እና መሬት እንዲገዙ በመፍቀዳቸው፣ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ የመብት መሸርሸር እና የኢኮኖሚ ልዩነት ስጋት ፈጥሯል። መንግስት እነዚህ እርምጃዎች ልማትን እና ውህደትን ለማምጣት ያለሙ ናቸው ቢልም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ ግን እርምጃዎቹ የአገሬው ተወላጆችን መብት የሚያሳጡ መሆናቸውን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Indiyaan bara 2019 mirga addaa Kaashmir ture erga haqxee booda, naannichi bulchiinsa kallattii Niiw Deelhiin jijjiirama siyaasaa fi uummataa guddaa keessa darbeera. Seerawwan haaroyni namoonni alaa akka naannichatti qabeenya horatanii fi lafa bitatan waan hayyamaniif, uummata naannichaa biratti sodaan mirga dhabuu fi wal-dhibdeen diinagdee dabaleera. Mootummaan tarkaanfiin kun guddinaa fi walitti makamuu kan fidu yoo jedhu, jiraattonni garuu tarkaanfichi uummata naannichaa mirga dhabsiisaa jira jedhanii amanu.

title: IRGC says won't reopen Hormuz until US accepts all Iran's conditions
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has announced that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States agrees to all of Iran's demands. Officials stated that they now view this vital waterway as a combat zone rather than a simple passage for trade. This decision signals a significant escalation in tensions as Iran uses the route to pressure Washington.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ጦር አሜሪካ የኢራንን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እስክትቀበል ድረስ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ዝግ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ ይህንን የባህር መስመር እንደ የንግድ ማስተላለፊያ ሳይሆን እንደ ጦርነት ቀጠና እንደሚመለከቱት ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ኢራን በዋሽንግተን ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር እየተጠቀመችበት ያለውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Raayyaan Ittisa Biyyattii Iraan, hanga Ameerikaan gaaffiiwwan Iraan hundatti waliigalutti, daandii bishaan Hormuz banuuf fedhii akka hin qabne beeksiseera. Hoggantoonni kunneen daandii bishaanii kana akka iddoo waraanaatti malee akka daandii daldalaatti ilaaluu akka hin barbaadne himaniiru. Murteen kun Iraan dhiibbaa Ameerikaa irraan ga'uuf tooftaa fayyadamaa jirtu ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: Talks with US won't happen while interim deal is breached, says Araghchi
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that direct negotiations with the United States are currently paused because of Washington's failure to honor an existing interim agreement. While official talks are halted, both nations are still communicating through third-party intermediaries. Additionally, Araghchi noted that a deal regarding shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz is nearly finalized but clarified that the waterway will not be reopened until specific conditions are met.
